Speaker: Ulysses

Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreet

Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreet

Speaker: Ulysses

Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreet
EN: {Beat, disgust, a little quieter - notices player's got ED-E with him}Judging by your shadow... maybe you can't let your machine go. Doesn't matter now.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreet
EN: Either way, the Divide giants are awakening. The missiles here, on their way home. {Cold}There is no way to stop them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreet
EN: You are too late. The Divide is awakening - the package, and the message within, have come full circle.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesForceGreet

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 4}
EN: {Cold}Thought that explosion, that building falling deep in the Divide might have been your work... wouldn't kill you, maybe close.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: AUDIO: Need more distortion here, Ulysses just cut in.
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 4}
EN: Knew you'd survive... but no need to go any farther. You've brought me what I need - that machine with you, sealed in the Hopeville silo.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 4}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 3}
EN: Hopeville, High Road, Ashton... tiny cracks in the Earth, {emph}nothing compared to the road carved ahead.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 3}
EN: Before you... this is the {emph}edge of the Divide. Ahead lies your work, the history you burned in the earth. {Beat, emph}What you brought to the people here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 2}
EN: {Contacting player through radio}There you are, you went quiet for a time... knew killing the Bear wouldn't prove easy... {slight disgust, hates ED-E}you and your machine, you survived.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 2}
EN: There's a lesson here, in the Divide. Old World history about paving and intentions could teach the Republic a thing or two - if they listened.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 2}
EN: They have an idea of trying to do what's right, never quite getting there. Maybe you've seen it - Nipton, elsewhere.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 2}
EN: {Contacting player through radio}Picking up the signal from your machine... was quiet for a time, thought the Road had claimed another of the Legion.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 2}
EN: Too many of the Bull have already fallen here... to radiation, fire... and what burrows below.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 2}
EN: {Contacting player through radio}There you are, you went quiet for a time... thought you might have returned to Vegas, its comforts. {Slight disgust}Maybe you took that machine with you.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 2}
EN: There's a lesson here, in the Divide. Old World history about holding on to something so tightly it breaks... or falls apart.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 2}
EN: May have seen the cracks in Vegas's walls already. If so, they'll grow, in time, no matter how much you back House.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 2}
EN: {Contacting player through radio}There you are, you went quiet for a time. {Beat, slight disgust for machine}Then that signal came in strong from your machine, like a heartbeat.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 2}
EN: Made your way through Old World towns, the tunnels that join them... now, the High Road.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {Ulysses Cut-In 2}
EN: For all you've seen behind you - {quieter}there's worse along this stretch. Deathclaws - hunt the Marked Men, {even quieter, for emphasis}and they also hunt what burrows below.

EN: My platoon has been wiped out, and I am pinned down by a goddamn huge Deathclaw in a place called the Divide!

Speaker: Trooper Gleeson
Topic_Name: NVDLC04NCRHolotape03
EN: So far I've been able to scare it away with flares, but I lack any explosives to kill the damn thing! Please assist! I say again, please assist!

Speaker: Trooper Gleeson
ActorNotes: [Dupe of first line of this info]
Topic_Name: NVDLC04NCRHolotape03
EN: {Dupe of first line of this info}Mayday, mayday, mayday! This is NCR Trooper Gleeson calling anyone listening on this channel.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatMarkedMenAllDead
EN: {All the Marked Men have died.}No more echoes of the Bull and the Bear. The rest will share their fate.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Slightly surprised, player destroyed all his robots]
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotsAllDestroyed
EN: {Slightly surprised, player destroyed all his robots}Didn't think you'd outlast the machines. {Slightly pleased, they can settle things personally}Good.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatMarkedMenEnter
EN: {Marked Men enter the temple, dismissive}The dead men of the New World... they've come for you.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Ulysses Fighting Eyebots have been turned against him, slight surprise]
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotsHostile01
EN: {Ulysses Fighting Eyebots have been turned against him, slight surprise}Took my machines? {To himself}Hnh. Underestimated you.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Ulysses Fighting Eyebots have been disabled, matter-of-fact]
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotsDisabled01
EN: {Ulysses Fighting Eyebots have been disabled, matter-of-fact}Just you and me, then. {Slight beat, firm}Always was.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Ulysses Healing Eyebots have been turned against him, slight anger]
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotsHostile02
EN: {Ulysses Healing Eyebots have been turned against him, slight anger}Machines might keep you alive, but they won't save you.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Ulysses Healing Eyebots have been disabled, dismissive]
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotsDisabled02
EN: {Ulysses Healing Eyebots have been disabled, dismissive}Can't stop the Old World's return, Courier.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Half of the Marked Men have died, combat is half over]
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendMarkedMenHalfDead
EN: {Half of the Marked Men have died, combat is half over}We've shown them fear, but not enough. More will come.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendMMUsesStealthboy
EN: {A Marked Man uses a stealthboy}Watch the shadows - the beasts cloak themselves in Old World tech.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [All the Marked Men are dead, combat is over.]
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendMarkedMenAllDead
EN: {All the Marked Men are dead, combat is over.}We've broken them. The Bear and the Bull have no more shadows to throw at us.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendSentryDies02
EN: {To himself}Old World's running out of machines.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendSentryDies01
EN: {To himself, robot is destroyed}Another Old World soldier falls.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt03
EN: You have forgotten all you were, traded glory for savagery. {Thoughtful}Fitting.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt02
EN: Mercy killings - let them rest.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendTaunt01
EN: {Dismissive}Beasts from the Divide. To the Divide, they return.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [A Marked Man is throwing satchel charges]
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendMMWithSatchelCharge
EN: {A Marked Man is throwing satchel charges}Watch the floor. Mines. {To himself}Tactics of the Bear.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Marked Men enter the Temple, combat starts]
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFriendMarkedMenEnter
EN: {Marked Men enter the Temple, combat starts}They come for us,  East and West alike.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt03
EN: {Grim, taunt}Running out of time, Courier.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt02
EN: {Taunt, dismissive}Come all this way - to die alone.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatTaunt01
EN: {Taunt, snarl}I'll end you - and your history.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatMarkedMenKilled02
EN: {Marked Men have been killed}Killing them is mercy.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotDestroyed02
EN: {Dismissive contempt, under his breath}Don't need Old World medicine to kill you.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Marked Men have been killed, cold contempt]
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatMarkedMenKilled01
EN: {Marked Men have been killed, cold contempt}Kill as many as you want - the Divide will birth more.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesCombatEyebotDestroyed01
EN: {Dismissive/contempt}Destroying my machines won't help you. This facility will make more.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: How are you speaking through ED-E?
EN: {Disgust}The idea of a machine bearing a message new to you? Thought that was how House relayed all his messages... {disdain}through his robots.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: ["You're hiding behind a machine," and Ulysses isn't sure what the player means at first]
Topic_Name: How are you speaking through ED-E?
EN: {"You're hiding behind a machine," and Ulysses isn't sure what the player means at first}The machine... the robot. No, not Legion... less history than that.{No sound file}

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: How are you speaking through ED-E?
EN: Last I heard, Legion didn't use machines as mouthpieces to hide from their enemy.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: How are you speaking through ED-E?
EN: {Frowns}The robot with {emph}you... {Beat, explains, disgust, hates ED-E}all of them are machines - radios, Old World tech reshaped with new hands. Historians. Couriers, carrying messages.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: How are you speaking through ED-E?
EN: Seen them as I've walked the Divide, tending other machines. {Frowns}That one... sealed inside the Hopeville silo. {Beat to himself}Sign America is waking up.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: How are you speaking through ED-E?
EN: {Cold, authoritative, hates ED-E}It will follow you, obey you. {Beat, low}Carry it until we are face to face, then there'll be no more need for it to carry {emph}my words.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Maybe you better tell me who you are, and what you want.
EN: {Slow, cold}I'm a courier. {Beat}Courier Six... was Courier Six. Like you - and {emph}not like you, in all the ways that matter.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Maybe you better tell me who you are, and what you want.
EN: {Low, slight threat}Spent too many years looking for you - now, letting you come to me.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Maybe you better tell me who you are, and what you want.
EN: Thought carrying that Chip would end you, no... you got lives in you, hard to kill. Storms, bullets... sand and wind, yet still you walk. For now.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Enough talking. You went to a lot of trouble to lure me here, so let's get on with this.
EN: {Cold, introspective}America sleeps ahead of you, its nightmares filled with quakes, storms. You'll need to find your own path.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Enough talking. You went to a lot of trouble to lure me here, so let's get on with this.
EN: That means waking America's spears up from their slumber. There's ways - warheads set off the collapse, {beat}warheads could open the gates again.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Enough talking. You went to a lot of trouble to lure me here, so let's get on with this.
EN: {Challenge}You're resourceful. {Disgust for machine}That machine, robot with you - can help you find the warheads you need to destroy... {a little slower, quest object}and their trigger, the detonator.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Enough talking. You went to a lot of trouble to lure me here, so let's get on with this.
EN: The way ahead is below. The tools are there. The rest - up to you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Are those the bodies I saw in the silo? The soldiers that look like they'd been flayed?
EN: If you saw their corpses, you saw mercy. Got what they deserved, coming to the Divide.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Are those the bodies I saw in the silo? The soldiers that look like they'd been flayed?
EN: The Bear and Bull - NCR, Legion - came in waves. Before. And after. Right into the invisible fires... the wind, ground... collapsing beneath them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Are those the bodies I saw in the silo? The soldiers that look like they'd been flayed?
EN: Once under different flags, now they are equal in their hatred of the trespassers. You and I.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What is this place?
EN: The Divide... this place is a slice of it. Old military. Can still smell the pride - and the fear.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What is this place?
EN: {Introspective}Hope of the Old World, wrapped in fencing, covered in storm. Got new inhabitants now other than ghosts, more recent... recruits.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Fine. I'll find this trigger - then I'll come find you.
EN: The Divide will send its worst against you - it may break you. We'll see if you're stronger.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Fine. I'll find this trigger - then I'll come find you.
EN: Road gets rougher from here... {slight disdain}Courier. Left marks for you, colors'll tell the way - if you're smart.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Fine. I'll find this trigger - then I'll come find you.
EN: They'll lead you to your home one more time, lead to the ending of it - {slow, cold}maybe remind you why you wander.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not planning to go into the Divide after you.
EN: No Courier would go to the Divide... but you will. And that's what sets us apart - we walk roads no other Courier will walk.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not planning to go into the Divide after you.
EN: And for you... you'll want to see your home one last time, see what happened.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not planning to go into the Divide after you.
EN: You're curious. You walk, leave ruin in your path... you can't leave alone. Still, the choice is yours... what I offer, it's the last I offer you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not planning to go into the Divide after you.
EN: I don't care if you walk the Divide. Turn, walk the Mojave, fight beneath the flags... but you'll wonder.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not planning to go into the Divide after you.
EN: If you don't, the Divide will come to you, and the Mojave. That will be my message to you, like the message you had for me.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The Long 15 is no more. The main supply line into NCR is cut.
EN: No damage done, not yet. Maybe in years. Keeps the Bear fenced... if Caesar can't drive it back, fire might.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The Long 15 is no more. The main supply line into NCR is cut.
EN: Only delays the end for the Bull, a new wall for them to scale and cross... once they're done with the Mojave. And Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The Long 15 is no more. The main supply line into NCR is cut.
EN: Never again do you or any other courier and caravan need walk that route. Let the Mojave breathe without that asphalt scar raking it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Dry Wells is destroyed - that was your birthplace?
EN: No, opposite of that. It's where my tribe was taken. Where another history was put to the blade, lesson taught.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Dry Wells is destroyed - that was your birthplace?
EN: It is where we realized Vulpes did not approach us as equals. Where we realized the wolf had come, and we watched our history die.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Dry Wells is destroyed - that was your birthplace?
EN: Now it belongs to Legion... and all the death there now belongs to them as well. Not revenge... just the way of things when you {emph}own them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I wanted to hear more about Hoover Dam.
EN: Old World wall, run red with blood of Bear and Bull. It'll bleed more before the sun sets on the Mojave.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I wanted to hear more about Hoover Dam.
EN: That place and I have a past, owe it a debt - and it owes me. If your path takes you there, know you're not the only one.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I wanted to hear more about Hoover Dam.
EN: It's the wall by which this age will be measured, the gravestone of the Mojave. Old World never meant it as such.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What are you doing here?
EN: A question one could have asked you not long ago, before walking the road West into the storms.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What are you doing here?
EN: Need to be here, see what was done. It's custom of the Bear to never see the marks it claws in the land... not {emph}my custom.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What are you doing here?
EN: Maybe that's why you've come, too - need to see where the missile from Ashton touched ground down below, in Hopeville... the Courier's Mile.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What are you doing here?
EN: Need to be here, see what was done. In the Divide, in Hopeville... the Courier's Mile.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What are you doing here?
EN: Can you tell me again what you're doing here?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Was hoping you could help me shape something.
EN: {Nods}Let's see what gifts the Mojave has for us.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Was hoping you could help me shape something.
EN: {Looking at player's inventory}Let's make something new from the old.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What did you mean, "slower death for the Mojave?"
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Nod}Death'll come from below. {Frowns}In the Divide, need to watch the sky {emph}and ground... {Dismissive, shakes head}Mojave'll be easy prey for them.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What did you mean, "slower death for the Mojave?"
EN: When you say, "slower death for the Mojave," you mean they're spreading out from the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What did you mean, "slower death for the Mojave?"
EN: [FAILED] Mojave needs to survive itself first... does that, Tunnelers will be next on the list.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If this is the High Road... where does it lead?
EN: At the end of the High Road lies Ashton - its silo.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If this is the High Road... where does it lead?
EN: {Disgust, hates ED-E}That {emph}machine with you, it can open it, wake it up, {quieter}like it did the one in Hopeville.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Some of the flayed Hopeville soldiers looked like NCR... but fought beside others in Legion armor.
EN: {Quieter}You see true. Not scavengers... it's what they wore {slight beat}before this all happened.{No sound file}

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Some of the flayed Hopeville soldiers looked like NCR... but fought beside others in Legion armor.
EN: [NCR] Those soldiers in Hopeville... were once NCR, I'm sure of it. Why were they with the Legion?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Some of the flayed Hopeville soldiers looked like NCR... but fought beside others in Legion armor.
EN: Pain makes for strange allies... the hate the Bear and Bull shared across the battlefield, now turned against the Divide. Few survived... intact.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Some of the flayed Hopeville soldiers looked like NCR... but fought beside others in Legion armor.
EN: Many NCR were already here when the destruction happened. Keeping the route East open, in fear of Caesar. Fear of the Legion.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Those Marked Men in Hopeville - some had strange masks and blades I'd never seen before.
EN: {Quieter}You haven't seen enough of the Legion yet to see what they worship... what they hold on to, even after what happened to them.{No sound file}

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Those Marked Men in Hopeville - some had strange masks and blades I'd never seen before.
EN: [Legion] Those Legionnaires in Hopeville wore Legion armor - and strange masks and blades.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Those Marked Men in Hopeville - some had strange masks and blades I'd never seen before.
EN: They bear false versions of Legate Lanius' mask, the one Caesar fashioned for him. Thought it was an insult at first.... {to himself}know better now.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Those Marked Men in Hopeville - some had strange masks and blades I'd never seen before.
EN: It's shaped from Divide metal, not with care and strength, but with hate. Keeps them anchored.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Those Marked Men in Hopeville - some had strange masks and blades I'd never seen before.
EN: Crude, effective - like the blades they carry, distant mirrors of their Legate. A symbol they can hold on to - while the Divide tears at them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What were the creatures in the underpass?
EN: Tunnelers. Predators that make their own roads beneath the ground here.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What were the creatures in the underpass?
EN: {Somber}Divide broke their sky, showed them the world above - and the scent of new prey.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What were the creatures in the underpass?
EN: Be a slower death for the Mojave than bombs and fire... but they'll come for its people, from where they least expect - below.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What happened here?
EN: You delivered a package. Had markings that matched those in the Divide. Not all... but enough.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What happened here?
EN: Military markings, from some place the Bear had savaged in the West. {Beat, trying to draw player out here}Maybe seeing those markings on it reminded you of home... made you carry it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This canyon is miles long - maybe longer. Where can I find you?
EN: At the end of the Divide, through the trenches and wreckage - that's where you'll find me. My new home, here, amongst dead men.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This canyon is miles long - maybe longer. Where can I find you?
EN: You and that {slight sneer at 'machine'}machine, keep your eyes on the tower that cuts the horizon... you'll find your way. Made it this far... not much farther to go.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT1HolotapeNote
EN: ...back again. Left that crater behind. Got a few holotapes left, ones from the medical center.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT1HolotapeNote
EN: The woman... she fixed the recorder. Said it wouldn't last, repayment for me fixing her. She doesn't like debts, can respect that.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT1HolotapeNote
EN: Payment enough, just to hear someone who believes in the Brotherhood of Steel. Not Elijah. Different view. Same madness.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT1HolotapeNote
EN: She answered me on their philosophy, their way of seeing - the roads they walk. {Disgust}Dead-ends. Empty... as if technology can solve anything.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT1HolotapeNote
EN: {Quiet, reflective}Big Empty's proof where that road leads. {Beat}Just like the Divide, and all the roads that lead to it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
EN: I walked the Great Salt Lake as Caesar's eye, then his hand.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
EN: Mongrels there, two-legs and four. Saw the walls of New Canaan the scavengers circled... hadn't the strength or fire to take. Too high, too strong.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
EN: White Legs, they were born for war, they run to it, hungry for battle... yet their hunger is to be a part of history, something larger.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
EN: Like the Legion. As always, brought them a message - from Caesar.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
EN: {Paraphrasing message from Caesar}If New Canaan burns, Caesar might {emph}see them. {Scoffs}"Might." Even the chance was a lie.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
EN: To honor Caesar - destroy the {emph}history of New Canaan, and the way they {emph}carry it - in their generations and family.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
EN: Caesar respects such strength, I told them. That - that was truth, even if "strength" wasn't the word. {Correcting}Obedience.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
EN: You must be willing to kill {emph}anyone, children, mothers, the weak, elders... if these New Canaanites value the generations, that is what you must kill.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
EN: It was like Vulpes was speaking through me. Use the night, silence, and fire to change their words to pleas, to screams.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
EN: No need for bombs when hate will do.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
EN: I... asked the White Legs to destroy a people with ancestry, going back thousands of years - another death of history, lost to time.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
EN: The New Canaanites... they supplied medicine. Food, traded with others. Civilization, a hand from the past, not history...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
EN: ...but maybe a past deeper, farther than that to a place where this... {beat}God really exists.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs2HolotapeNote
EN: {Dismissive}If so, his handiwork and people belong elsewhere, not in this place. Another symbol, like Bear and Bull, with no meaning in the present.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Studying weather, log to himself, thinking back]
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote
EN: {Studying weather, log to himself, thinking back}Emptiness here - like the sands of the Great Salt Lake, echoed. {Beat}The beating in the Divide sky... like storm drums of the White Legs.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote
EN: {Introspective}Ran with them on the salt beds, at Caesar's command - {recalling Caesar's orders, echoing them}cut the throats of the two-headed Bear, cut all communities off.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote
EN: Use storm, sky. Disease. Fire, starvation... and the violence of the ignorant to ruin all who {emph}could... might stand against him.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote
EN: But the White Legs... they couldn't live on their own, like most scavengers. So gave them purpose - turned their hunger into a weapon.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote
EN: The wall of New {CANE-in}Canaan... too high for Caesar. Too proud, maybe - {quiet}or maybe something there, from his past, that needed killing. Memory of Graham.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote
EN: Helped them dig out Canaan supply caches, and other secrets the sands hid - bunkers, filled with powered weapons even the Brotherhood might desire.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote
EN: They called these new weapons "storm drums" in the firing of shells. Taught them the power in the casings... to channel the spirits in their guns.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote
EN: Me... they called me the Flag-Bearer. Glory in my hand, in my staff that still bore the weight of the Old World just as the symbol on my back did.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote
EN: I learned their weapons as a means of respect. And when it came their turn to pay respect to me... history came rushing back.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs1HolotapeNote
EN: {Quiet, bring to a close}Can't escape what's been done. History's there... no matter how far you walk.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: Have you ever wanted to speak to history - just to know the why of it? {Beat}I don't. Not any longer.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: There's old stories about gods and men, past history, into myth - where the gods, they're like children... petulant, cruel.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: {Emph}Those were the voices of the Big Empty, the past. Couldn't leave well enough alone, had to ask. Had to ask the why of it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: {Slight frustration}Their answers were madness. And power, stronger than me, would take a hundred Elijahs... someone tougher than him or I to best them in their Dome.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: They didn't know why they were there, what had led to that point, their names - like serpents devouring themselves, cannibalizing their own thoughts.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: When all seemed lost, thought it was the end - my anger gave me strength to ask them my last question.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Echoing the question he asked the Think Tank]
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: {Echoing the question he asked the Think Tank}"Who are you, that do not know your history?"

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: {Slight reverence}And they awoke. For... a short time.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: The flag you wear, they said. We remember. America.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: It wasn't just a flag to them... it was a place, an idea they had {emph}cared for. Once.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: They told me what it was like to grow in that world... all they had done to lift it up... protect it. They... didn't know it was gone, that...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: ...yet they had cared once. Before forgetting their history.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: As they were talking... kept seeing the Courier's shadow behind them, giving each their words weight. History cast aside... a home, left behind.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: I listened. I asked. Was there anything left? {Emph}Anything that still carries America's voice?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: And they told me I had already been there. I and one other, walking right out of history deeper than we knew.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT3HolotapeNote
EN: They told me what lies in the heart of the Divide, what can be found there. And the words to awaken it - and the one to speak them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT2HolotapeNote
EN: Big Empty - there's something hidden there, a crater, past wind and sand - so deep in the desert, there's no turning back.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT2HolotapeNote
EN: Finding the crater was an accident, was following the weather patterns - the Divide sky torn like that, man's violence, not nature's.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT2HolotapeNote
EN: That violence in the sky, had a source. Tracked it. Like following a river current.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT2HolotapeNote
EN: Left the colors to mark my way, like always, case someone finds them, learns the pattern - the Courier might.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT2HolotapeNote
EN: When I thought sand and wind would never end... came to the crater.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT2HolotapeNote
EN: And there... there was an Old World facility, a weather station, at the edge, still raking the sky with electricity and generators.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT2HolotapeNote
EN: And beyond it... saw the rest of the Old World hell there, all carved up like garden plots. Had to see what was there, couldn't leave it be.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT2HolotapeNote
EN: {Slight irritation}Things sleep in the Big Empty, the Brotherhood woke them up - can't move quiet, any more than the two-headed Bear can.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesBigMT2HolotapeNote
EN: And when they woke up, it was like all of history waking up at once. Almost didn't make it out. {Beat, quiet}Almost. Left with answers I never intended.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape
EN: Last tape, last message. In case... you best me. If you're hearing this, you have, through blood or word.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape
EN: This message, and all that lies with it - it is for you, Courier. If you want to know the... why of things.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape
EN: This world, I've walked a good part of it... I stopped only because of you. What you did - gave me pause.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape
EN: Long ago, I crossed the Colorado, the first among the Legion to see Hoover Dam in all its glory... an Old World wall, yet bridging two sides.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape
EN: {Quieter}And beyond it, a symbol of a two-headed Bear, an idea great enough to challenge Caesar himself.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape
EN: Might kill him, taking it, whether he won or lost. The Bull needs to fight, needs the challenge, without it... it falters, dies in the dust.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape
EN: {To himself}Might be a lesson there, in you and me. {"I'll"}Leave the thought behind the message to you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape
EN: My message is this - the destruction that has been wrought, at the Divide - or elsewhere, if you couldn't stop me...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape
EN: It can happen again. It will {emph}keep happening.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape
EN: If war doesn't change, men must change, and so must their symbols. {Beat, quiet}Even if it is nothing at all, know what you follow, Courier...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape
EN: ...just as I followed you, to the end. Whatever your symbol...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesFinalMsgHolotape
EN: ...carry it on your back, and wear it proudly when you stand at Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3HolotapeNote
EN: The White Legs... meant to show respect, bribe me for Caesar's favor, echoing mannerisms and words...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3HolotapeNote
EN: Showed them tech caches, taught them the workings of chamber and powder, spoke of Caesar's {emph}pride in those that used such things... lies. And...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3HolotapeNote
EN: {quiet disgust}...and then... they tried to honor {emph}me - not the Legion.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3HolotapeNote
EN: They brought me before the campfire one night, showed me how they changed themselves, how they wore their hair now.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3HolotapeNote
EN: It was like my entire dead tribe in the firelight, teeth grinning red in the dark - eager corpses, blood-covered ghosts.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3HolotapeNote
EN: They... had taken my braids, the way of the Twisted Hairs, as if it showed they were {emph}like me, {emph}of me...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3HolotapeNote
EN: ...while every knot in their braids spoke of raping, violence - and ignorance of what the knots {emph}meant. They thought to show respect... defiled it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3HolotapeNote
EN: Lost myself in trying to read the braids they wove, when I remembered they had put no meaning in it. They had no history of what it meant.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3HolotapeNote
EN: They didn't even know the insult in the twists, knots... and Dry Wells came rushing back, the White Legs circled like that...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04UlyssesWhiteLegs3HolotapeNote
EN: It was like looking at the dead of my tribe, reborn as ghosts - hateful, hungry, bowing to Caesar. {Quiet, bring to a close}Another history... gone, carried by me alone.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Find anything in the dust of Hopeville?
EN: Nothing but wind, sand... ash. More may reveal itself in time, not now.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Find anything in the dust of Hopeville?
EN: If you're determined, return, might be something new surfaces.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Find anything in the dust of Hopeville?
EN: Wind and blood has uncovered more beneath the soil.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Find anything in the dust of Hopeville?
EN: If you want these Old World relics, they're yours... better you carry them than the Marked Men.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: Not a camp - vigil, maybe. Never claimed it as mine. {More a question}If anyone owns the Divide... {"well..."}your claim is stronger than mine.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: Don't feel like adding a campfire to the ones that already burn below. {Beat, making offer}If you brought Mojave gifts, might be able to shape something for the road.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: Depends what history has to say about them. There's a lot the land can provide... if you know the road that led to it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: Mojave's got ways of healing most ills - if not, some tribe's usually found a way you didn't expect.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: Like Healing Powders. Tribes back West only use Xander and Broc flower. There's a way the Twin Mothers in the East used to brew it, though.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: Called it Bitter Drink, mixed up the Xander and Broc in a bottle, added some kick to it so your head doesn't get all clouded.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: Any recipes you can teach?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: {Thinking}Antivenom's helpful around the Mojave with the Bark Scorpions. Even one sting can kill you. {Beat}Tunneler bite can be just as bad.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: My tribe, Twisted Hairs, had a better way than Antivenom, if you act fast.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: Snakebite Tourniquet - cuts off the venom, no need to scavenge glands and blood. {Himself, slight disgust}Or drink that mess.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: Part of the reason we wore our hair like we did, {corrects self}like I do now.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: Here's some for the road - trick to making it's not hard. {Beat}Get bit, hook and twist it. Fast as blinking, doesn't give poison time to sink in.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: Any more recipes.. or histories... you can teach?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: Nothing more than I've already shared. We'll have to keep with what we know. {Beat}Tired of history's lessons, anyway.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Is this where you're making camp?
EN: Any more recipes you can teach?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I had other questions.
EN: {Matter-of-fact}Questions have a habit of making others.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The Divide's irradiated... are you sure you want to stay here?
EN: The invisible fires burn here, true enough. Still... to have helped carry out such an act, then not face it...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The Divide's irradiated... are you sure you want to stay here?
EN: Not my way. If my life burns out here, so be it... until then, I wait and watch, see what the road brings.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What about the Marked Men?
EN: That's part of why I'm here. Watch them - if they attack me, try to enter the Mojave, I answer. {Little quieter}Not looking to kill them... save them, if I can.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What about the Marked Men?
EN: There might be something saving in them. {Quieter, to himself}If not, then what I do is mercy, not murder.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What's the Courier's Mile? Is that where the Ashton missile hit?
EN: My name for it. If you have a better one, you grant it - my choice in names won't carry past you and I.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What's the Courier's Mile? Is that where the Ashton missile hit?
EN: Lies along the road, running from the Hopeville silo... straight on to where the ground burns, and wind howls even stronger than here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Your tapes prove you've walked the Mojave, yet learned the wrong lessons.
EN: Comes down to perspective, how far one's walked, and what they've left behind.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Your tapes prove you've walked the Mojave, yet learned the wrong lessons.
EN: {Challenging}If you challenge this moment, let's hear your perspective. If my words are all you have, let's hear them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So... you think dropping bombs on the Mojave is going to solve things?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Thinking}The why of it... you taught me the why of it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So... you think dropping bombs on the Mojave is going to solve things?
EN: If you believe in something enough, you must be willing to let it burn, lest it claim you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So... you think dropping bombs on the Mojave is going to solve things?
EN: These governments of the two-headed bear... the Legion... they carry Old World ideas into an age that no longer needs them, where they cannot live.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: So... you think dropping bombs on the Mojave is going to solve things?
EN: I need to know why you're doing this - not for my sake, for history's sake.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So... you think dropping bombs on the Mojave is going to solve things?
EN: [FAILED] Yes, that is what you proved to me at the Divide - what is here, what you showed me... it is enough.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So... you think dropping bombs on the Mojave is going to solve things?
EN: You don't understand. {Beat}You will.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You've wasted enough of my time. Get ready to die.
EN: {DUPE}I'll finish history's work. If the Divide couldn't kill you... perhaps these spears of the Old World can.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You've wasted enough of my time. Get ready to die.
EN: {DUPE}Let's end this, Courier, you and I. Here, with the Old World flag as witness.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: You've wasted enough of my time. Get ready to die.
EN: I've heard enough. You're a Legion traitor, and now you'll die.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Can you share the recipe with me?
EN: Can do that and one better... {looking around}just enough around to mix some. Here - might make the Twin Mothers' history live a little longer, you carrying it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Can you share the recipe with me?
EN: {Warning}When you drink it, down it all in one shot, or your stomach's not going to want to keep going after the second drink.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Smiles, "you want to know the history of it?"]
Topic_Name: What's the history of it?
EN: {Smiles, "you want to know the history of it?"}History? Cures a wound, leaves the bitterness that caused it. {To himself, scorn}The Twin Mothers were always about lessons.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What's the history of it?
EN: Caesar taught them the last one, though, so that's it for them. Recipe still exists, Legion uses it on forced marches with wounded soldiers.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What's the history of it?
EN: Wouldn't have made it through Crimson River Trail a few years back without it  - losing so much blood early on, was a Cazador feast.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What's the history of it?
EN: Enough Xander root and Broc flower along the trail though, the Legion was able to keep pace and get where they were going.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Have you been to Hopeville since the Ashton missile hit?
EN: {Reflective}Walk there sometimes, keep the walks short. Still... it's important to see. Something else to answer for.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Have you been to Hopeville since the Ashton missile hit?
EN: Occasionally sift through the dust, the buildings... see if I can find some history. Marks of America.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Have you been to Hopeville since the Ashton missile hit?
EN: If you want them, keep them... you've earned it. Nothing to be gained by me holding them, and more will surface in time.

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: You'd better level with me, trashcan, or I might stuff you back in that pod.
EN: <Apologetic beeping>{NPCRobotEdEDenied}

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: Yeah, he's probably dead. Guess that means I own you now.
EN: <Sad beeping>{NPCRobotEdESad}

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: Great. Maybe you'll actually be useful to me, then.
EN: <Hopeful beeping>{NPCRobotEdEConfirmed}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset02
EN: {Narration}{Male - correcting the previous statement}Men do, through the roads they walk.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset02
EN: {Narration}{Female - correcting the previous statement - war never changes}Women do, through the roads they walk.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideSunset01
EN: {Narration}It's said war - war never changes.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide02
EN: {Narration}Tunnelers and the Marked Men... avoided the lone figure, as if recognizing the Courier's right to passage... or out of fear.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide0
EN: {Narration}{Male}As for the Courier... he turned his back on his home for the second time and made his way back, navigating the treachery of the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideDivide0
EN: {Narration}{Female}As for the Courier... she turned her back on her home for the second time and made her way back, navigating the treachery of the Divide.

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed02
EN: {Narration}As his last gesture, he sent one last signal to his counterpart in the Mojave, passing along what the Courier had taught him in the Divide.

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed02
EN: {Narration}There was the chance... always, that ED-E's journey would continue, perhaps carried by another Eyebot in the Mojave...

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed02
EN: {Narration}...the one from which the ED-E from the Divide had been shaped.

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed02
EN: {Narration}For now, the Courier knew ED-E's history and could carry it, even if the Eyebot had forgotten.

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed01
EN: {Narration}When ED-E's circuits burned in the fires of the Divide, there was one small part that held on until the end.

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESacrificed01
EN: {Narration}It was the fragment that held the Old World memories and the words of his creator in his last moments.

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDELeftBehind
EN: {Narration}ED-E, the version given life by the machines of the Divide, remained frozen in the military installation where Ulysses had summoned him.

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDELeftBehind
EN: {Narration}The robot's last coded transmission back to his counterpart in the Mojave told of upgrades, unlocked memories... then silence.

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDELeftBehind
EN: {Narration}Not long after the Courier left the facility, the Eyebot's data banks were wiped, and it was disassembled as rapidly as it had been constructed.

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESaved02
EN: {Narration}Before leaving, he sent a coded signal to his original in the Mojave, passing along what the Courier had taught him in the Divide.

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESaved02
EN: {Narration}With that last farewell, he set off, carrying the song of Old World hope with him, which had given him strength and purpose on his journey.

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingSlideEDESaved02
EN: {Narration}{Downnote}And no matter what, he knew there would be a second home to return to, Navarro or not - and that his creator would be proud.

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingEDESaved01
EN: {Narration}ED-E, given second life by the machines of the Divide, freed by the Courier, continued his quest west, to Navarro...

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingEDESaved01
EN: {Narration}...or what remained of what the Eyebot considered "home." Whether he found his homeland or not, his road is unknown.

Speaker: ED-E
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingEDESaved01
EN: {Narration}It may be the journey meant more than the destination - just as his counterpart in the Mojave had learned.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingUlyssesAlive02
EN: {Narration}He remained there, perhaps as punishment for the scars he left on the wastes - or a reminder of a history he could not forget.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingUlyssesAlive02
EN: {Narration}For Ulysses... his journey was over. The Courier had been the end of {"emph" refers to Ulysses}his road.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingUlyssesAlive01
EN: {Narration}Hopeville burned lightless in the night, invisible fires of radiation scorching it from within and without.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingUlyssesAlive01
EN: {Narration}It is said a man still walked its streets, with a tattered jacket, an Old World flag etched on the back...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingUlyssesDead02
EN: {Narration}...though whether done as a sign of respect, or in anger for what had been endured to reach this moment - that is unknown.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingUlyssesDead02
EN: {Narration}Interpretation is something best left to history, and only the surviving Courier would ever know for certain.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingUlyssesDead01
EN: {Narration}At the end of the struggle, only one Courier remained in the heart of the Divide. The {emph}true Courier, Courier Six.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingUlyssesDead01
EN: {Narration}The Courier tore the ancient flag of the Commonwealth from its cables, and cast it over the corpse...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchLegion02
EN: {Narration}{Knowingly, confidentially}But that message - it is something for Couriers to carry, and for them alone.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchLegion02
EN: {Narration}{Bring it to a close}The lights flickered across the Divide, reminders that the Old World histories persist, and find meaning in the present.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchLegion01
EN: {Narration}{Male}The Courier walked until he stood again upon the edge of the Divide, the last road he would walk before the second battle for Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchLegion01
EN: {Narration}{Male}There, beside his feet, was a final package, from one Courier to another - a footlocker, bearing a gift, and a message.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchLegion01
EN: {Narration}{Female}The Courier walked until she stood again upon the edge of the Divide, the last road she would walk before the second battle for Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchLegion01
EN: {Narration}{Female}There, beside her feet, was a final package, from one Courier to another - a footlocker, bearing a gift, and a message.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR02
EN: {Narration}{Target: NCR}As catastrophic as the damage was for NCR, the act made the Courier stronger for having no history, and no retreat.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR02
EN: {Narration}It was an ending to things - a way of erasing the road that had led to this point and the history that had walked with it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR02
EN: {DUPE}{Narration}{Target: Legion}It was an ending to things - a way of erasing the road that had led to this point and the history that had walked with it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR01
EN: {Narration}{Target: NCR}...missiles fell on NCR and the Long 15 caravan route beyond the Mojave Outpost, the road the Courier had been walking when the tale began.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR01
EN: {Narration}Caravans and NCR outposts along the route were reduced to ash, an Old World gift from the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR01
EN: {Narration}{Target: Legion}...missiles fell on the East and the Legion encampment at Dry Wells... where the Twisted Hairs had allied, then been betrayed by Vulpes and Caesar.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: NVDLC04EndingMissileLaunchNCR01
EN: {Narration}Legion soldiers died, their silhouettes blasted into the ground and earth, the last word of the last of the Twisted Hairs.
