Topic_Name: I'm not interested in your politics.
EN: Not going to waste time trying to make the blind see. {Beat}Took a chance coming here - same as I did. Now we'll see how it plays out.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I'm not interested in your politics.
EN: We're too far from Vegas to argue perspective on it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not interested in your politics.
EN: Maybe not. Maybe that's why you fell in with the Bear in the first place - can't see what you're following.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not interested in your politics.
EN: Not going to convince a deaf man with words. Shown strength coming in here - if strength's what you respect, then you belong East of the Colorado.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: At least they're trying to help the Mojave.
EN: Trying doesn't hold much weight with me. Legion doesn't {emph}try to kill people, they do it. The Bear kills people trying to {emph}protect them.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: At least they're trying to help the Mojave.
EN: Irony's sharp. And Legion... their flag may be old, but it's not at war with itself.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: At least they're trying to help the Mojave.
EN: No matter now. Bear couldn't hold the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: At least they're trying to help the Mojave.
EN: You and that machine, are all that remains of NCR here... {quieter, to himself}rest fell to radiation, fire... and what burrows below.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You've got a better way?
EN: Yes. And any Courier could tell you the same, see it everywhere. The Bear...{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You've got a better way?
EN: ...Bear's too busy carving up the Mojave with knives, roads, borders, and how things {emph}should be to see how it {emph}is.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You've got a better way?
EN: They're stretched thin, can't protect their frontlines, their towns, think paper's power, radio means control - all of it, useless.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You have a lot of hate for NCR. That kind of hate isn't new in the Mojave.
EN: No... not new. And not new among all those in the shadow of the Bear.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You have a lot of hate for NCR. That kind of hate isn't new in the Mojave.
EN: {Frowns}You know their flag, a bear with two heads. Symbol's an Old World one, had one head then, better off for it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You have a lot of hate for NCR. That kind of hate isn't new in the Mojave.
EN: Their flag speaks to their spirit. They're split like any two-headed animal, trying to go in different directions, ending up nowhere.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You have a lot of hate for NCR. That kind of hate isn't new in the Mojave.
EN: In the Mojave, that'll only get you sand between your fingers - or over your grave.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is New Vegas's power a threat to you?
EN: {Dismissive}Power isn't strength. Power can wall off someone, when they {slight emph}believe it's freed them.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is New Vegas's power a threat to you?
EN: House's power... {Beat, lets it go}you've seen the wall around Vegas. He gains more power, that wall will grow. The Mojave'll become Vegas.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Little quiet, as if speaking of a haunted graveyard]
Topic_Name: Is New Vegas's power a threat to you?
EN: {Little quiet, as if speaking of a haunted graveyard}But it's more lights than strength. You'll see the way of it soon enough.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is that why you're not Legion anymore, then?
EN: {Slight surprise}What do you m... {"mean," then chuckles}I see the way of it. Have fight in you, at least. Save it for the road ahead.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: A woman in the Legion surprise you?
EN: It's not Legion - the Legion I know, but they change, even in small ways as they march West, with every tribe they break.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: A woman in the Legion surprise you?
EN: {Dismissive}But yes... last I heard, you needed a weapon between your legs to carry one for Caesar.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: "Brothers?" So - you're Legion, too.
EN: I hold Legion to be my brothers... even as misguided as they are. And you... more so than most.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Storage Node Ulysses talking about player being Legion. Do not translate. >
EN: Heard tales of you walking the Mojave. Casting off your disguise... yet you carried that Chip, determined to take it to Vegas... not Caesar.{No Sound File}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Storage Node Ulysses talking about player being Legion. Do not translate. >
EN: You and that Chip deserve each other, 29 fewer coins than other traitors have carried, by history's mark.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The Mojave is behind us. I want to know what's ahead.
EN: The High Road... not the Divide yet, many more miles to walk. But you got this far. {Disgust, hates ED-E}You and that machine that shadows you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The Mojave is behind us. I want to know what's ahead.
EN: Wasn't sure if both of you'd make it - above, then below the underpass.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I doubt you've ever met House.
EN: No... only seen his works. Those he's broken with light and gold. His messengers.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I doubt you've ever met House.
EN: But everything in Vegas speaks of someone who can't let go.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I doubt you've ever met House.
EN: House takes a shovel to history's graves, props up the dead, then puts words in their mouths. The tribes don't even know how they were broken.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I doubt you've ever met House.
EN: {Cold, ominous}Not a world I want to be part of, going through motions until we're all smiling faces on some robot's screen.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: House is more pragmatic than you might think.
EN: {"I"}Believe that. Vegas runs, I've seen what it's done to those who oppose it. And I've seen its messengers.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Tribes? You mean the Vegas families?
EN: Families of Vegas were once tribes. Got drunk on the Vegas lights, the spirit bled out of them. Old World history, under a different flag.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Tribes? You mean the Vegas families?
EN: Whatever traditions or rituals they had, most likely squeezed out of them by now, turned into something else.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Tribes? You mean the Vegas families?
EN: {To himself}And if not, then I'm afraid what's going to happen when they come creeping back.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Vegas is one of the safest places in the Mojave, and that gives me hope.
EN: You've been, you've seen the Wall. Safe? No... what's inside - that's what worries me.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Vegas is one of the safest places in the Mojave, and that gives me hope.
EN: Inside, Old World's waking up. No facts or history I've heard tells me that city ever went to sleep, and that makes me think.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Vegas is one of the safest places in the Mojave, and that gives me hope.
EN: The blue of the Mojave skies - isn't like the rest of the world. Don't hear a Geiger ticking there, more to fear from predators than rads.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Vegas is one of the safest places in the Mojave, and that gives me hope.
EN: The city - the whole Mojave, wasn't hit by bombs. Been my call, Vegas would be one of the first pieces of the Old World to burn.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Vegas is one of the safest places in the Mojave, and that gives me hope.
EN: Someone protected it. Wasn't chance, wasn't luck. Something larger - yet they let the rest of the world suffer. And they'll do it again.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What did you mean before, "it's a dance?"
EN: {Frowns}That's the wrong word. "Theater" is better - the families, the Bear all on a stage.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What did you mean before, "it's a dance?"
EN: House. He's the one watching. {Suspicious}The why... you'd know better than I would. If you don't - you will.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What do you have against Vegas?
EN: Vegas is Old World, filled with Old World ghosts. {Beat, slightly ominous}And ghosts need the living to do their work.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What do you have against Vegas?
EN: That's why the families are there, why the Bear stumbles there to lose itself. It's a dance, I don't know its purpose.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What do you have against Vegas?
EN: You've been, you've seen the Wall. It's what's inside that worries me.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: As obsessed as you are about history, the future's what I prefer.
EN: {Disdain}Your future with House has two roads. The road the tribals in Vegas walked... their spirits crushed...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: As obsessed as you are about history, the future's what I prefer.
EN: ...or your face on a robot servant, smiling forever in a dead casino. There's future in neither.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Storage Node Ulysses giving player final direction. Do not translate. >
EN: {Commanding}For now - find the trigger for the warheads, buried in Hopeville. Use it to keep moving... and keep alive.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Wait... there's more I wanted to talk about. About... all this.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Smiles}"Who are you, who do not know your history?"

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Wait... there's more I wanted to talk about. About... all this.
EN: You came all this way for answers. Only currency I have, nothing else to be gained - {you}could turn around, walk away at any time.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Wait... there's more I wanted to talk about. About... all this.
EN: If history matters to you... you'll need to earn it. {To himself, this is a hint}Any logs of mine I have already cast away in the Divide, they're lost to you.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Wait... there's more I wanted to talk about. About... all this.
EN: If we share history, then before going forward, I want to know the past.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Wait... there's more I wanted to talk about. About... all this.
EN: [FAILED] {Dismissive}You want to know more, keep walking.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Wait... there's more I wanted to talk about. About... all this.
EN: I'll give answers as you go. {Beat, warning}Not before.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Are you saying... they were here before all this destruction?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Nod}Makes sense. Truth favors that, matches the history of this place.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Are you saying... they were here before all this destruction?
EN: {Reflective}Were signs they were here for a long time, before Marked Men, before what happened to the Divide cracked their sky.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Are you saying... they were here before all this destruction?
EN: If so, they were buried deep. Might have been born the day America's embers started to settle. {To himself}Seen worse things twisted by radiation.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Are you saying... they were here before all this destruction?
EN: Radiation from the War might have created them. Then detonations, quakes, caused them to surface?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Are you saying... they were here before all this destruction?
EN: [FAILED] {Dismissive}Don't know the history of them - only their patterns, how they hunt.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Are you saying... they were here before all this destruction?
EN: {Dismissive}Still, takes a long time for such patterns to develop. A longer history than what happened here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Storage Node: Ulysses discussing Denver and the East. Do not Translate. >
EN: Walked the East, too, before the Bull came. Then... much like the Mojave before the Bear... tribes, towns, clutching to life. Bull did a better job.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Denver? What's that?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Mojave and the Divide aren't the only places I've walked.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Denver? What's that?
EN: "Denver hounds?" Denver's far to the East - Legion territory.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Denver? What's that?
EN: [FAILED] Another city fallen to nations, in the east... not important. {Dismissive, player isn't much of an outdoorsman}Doubt you'll ever walk that far, you'd need the land to sustain you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] You've been to Denver? That's Legion territory.
EN: Mojave and the Divide aren't the only places I've walked.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Storage Node: Ulysses is discussing tunnelers and the future. Do not Translate. >
EN: They'll start emerging throughout the Mojave in time, might be years. Probably less.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Storage Node: Ulysses is discussing tunnelers and the future. Do not Translate. >
EN: They breed fast, hunt in groups, more than enough to bring down the strongest in the Mojave. Once they draw blood...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Storage Node: Ulysses is discussing tunnelers and the future. Do not Translate. >
EN: Seen them tear apart Deathclaws... Deathclaw might get some, but the rest will swarm it, tear it apart, like Denver hounds.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You've been to Denver? That's Legion territory.
EN: {DUPE}Mojave and the Divide aren't the only places I've walked.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Maybe you should tell me what happened.
EN: NCR saw the worth in that road you made. {Disgust}Staked a claim, whether it was wanted there or not - {just like it’s}true elsewhere in the Mojave.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Maybe you should tell me what happened.
EN: And where the Bear tries to cling to life, the Legion comes... bearing messages. Some brought by blade. Others... by Couriers.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Maybe you should tell me what happened.
EN: You knew what was coming, as sure as I know what's coming for you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Maybe you should tell me what happened.
EN: This time {emph}you carry the burden. {Beat}Walk west into the sun, and keep walking until it dies. {Beat}There - I'll be waiting.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: There is no other supply line to the Mojave beyond the Long 15.
EN: {Scoffs}Not any more. If one existed, the two-headed Bear would have claimed it. And it tried to.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You're still making assumptions about all this.
EN: No, recounting history.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Whatever you believe happened, you have it wrong.
EN: {Raises an eyebrow, contempt}Wrong? {Beat}No, I know the truth of it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Whatever you believe happened, you have it wrong.
EN: It was you walking that road that kept the Divide alive. It grew from what you did. Settlers... camps... filling that Old World city.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Whatever you believe happened, you have it wrong.
EN: {To himself}Chance for a new nation, new beginning. New way of thinking.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Whatever you believe happened, you have it wrong.
EN: {Bitter}Could've breathed new life into the Mojave, bridging East, West. Like Hoover Dam... but not Old World, something {emph}you made. Road was a supply line.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You're crazy. Your head's messed up worse than the Divide.
EN: {Cold, judging, low}And you've forgotten. Forgotten everything. {Beat, emph}Careless, as careless with futures then as you are now in the Mojave.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I've walked a lot of hard roads, Mojave and before. Doesn't mean anything.
EN: {Anger}It means {emph}everything - even if you {emph}deny it, cast it aside, that speaks to what you are, {emph}proves what happened here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Placeholder Node: Ulysses talking about the Divide history. Do Not Translate >
EN: Never would have known the Divide had it not been for you. {Deliberate, slow, little anger here}The road you made with your tracks, again and again.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Placeholder Node: Ulysses talking about the Divide history. Do Not Translate >
EN: {Thinking}You were the only one willing to make the journey to and from here... a hard road. Kept the land before the Divide alive through seasons, storms...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Placeholder Node: Ulysses talking about the Divide history. Do Not Translate >
EN: {trying to convince himself}{emph}...can't have been just a job. {Accusing}Was something more to you. Don't feel for a place that hard unless it's home.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You keep saying that, as if you know where I was born - you don't.
EN: Home isn't where you're born into this world. You taught me that. Part of your message, whether you meant it or not.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You keep saying that, as if you know where I was born - you don't.
EN: {Reflective}Can be a place of mind, a moment where you know who you are, the history of it. {Beat, back to player}And they can be places you breathe life into.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not done talking to you yet, there's more I want to know.
EN: Already heard you once, long ago and loud enough for history to hear. Tired of your messages.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not done talking to you yet, there's more I want to know.
EN: {Slight snide}Still - curiosity drove you this far. Let's see what else it can do.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You wanted me to come to the Divide, I'm here. Now what?
EN: Your road's not done. Haven't walked it full yet, not nearly enough.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I've had enough of this - whatever your game, I'm done.
EN: {Cold}No, {emph}you are. Cut off your retreat, {emph}your supply line. Ashton missile, turned Hopeville into a furnace.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I've had enough of this - whatever your game, I'm done.
EN: You could walk back. Still can - {slow}but the Divide will mark you, sickness will set in.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I've had enough of this - whatever your game, I'm done.
EN: Not immediate, maybe, but in time. Slow burn, a little faster than before.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I've had enough of this - whatever your game, I'm done.
EN: The way ahead and below - leads to the heart of the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I've had enough of this - whatever your game, I'm done.
EN: And there... you and I, we'll have an ending to things.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I had no idea the silo was active until the missile was in the air toward Hopeville.
EN: Didn't stop you, though. Like carrying the Chip to Vegas, Old World death in your hand.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I had no idea the silo was active until the missile was in the air toward Hopeville.
EN: Pieces of the Old World like that just need someone careless enough to take them where they need to go, to do their killing.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand how a package could have done this.
EN: You will. I'll show the Mojave, Bear and Bull the way of it. How Couriers can break nations.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand how a package could have done this.
EN: What happened here... can happen again. {Quiet, slight smug}You've already proved it, what you did in Ashton. The silo there.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You can't be sure it was me.
EN: No... I'm certain. What I hadn't known was that you still {emph}lived after the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not responsible for this, there's no way I could have known.
EN: {Emph}If you had been there when it happened. {Beat, quieter}If you had {emph}seen the Divide break, you would know it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not responsible for this, there's no way I could have known.
EN: You carry death wherever you go - if the Mojave doesn't know it yet, it will.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This package... I don't recall it.
EN: It was from the West. From deep in NCR. Whether made by them or not... it came here. Through your hands.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Let a little bit of rage creep in here, this is what he hates]
Topic_Name: You said I brought it from the West?
EN: {Let a little bit of rage creep in here, this is what he hates}It was a device, a detonator. One I'd never seen before - {little quieter, to himself}or heard before.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You said I brought it from the West?
EN: {Emph}You carried that thing to the Divide. I know because I followed you as you walked the road, watched you do it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You said I brought it from the West?
EN: You brought it here, to the community you built. And you are responsible for what happened after - when the device opened, started to speak.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You said I brought it from the West?
EN: When it did, the Divide answered back. {Beat}Those missiles you've seen, buried in their silos.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You said I brought it from the West?
EN: They exploded beneath the ground, cracked the landscape. Sand, ash... the dead... the Divide skies became a graveyard.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The logs of the Big Empty mentioned you'd spoken to history.
EN: {Slow, thinking back}I had, did. It was madness... asked them a question in anger. {Beat}Got an answer, more than I expected.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The logs of the Big Empty mentioned you'd spoken to history.
EN: {Quiet, to himself}Answer told me what happened here at the Divide, the how of it, and that was enough.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The logs of the Big Empty mentioned you'd spoken to history.
EN: {Resolved, closing this up}The tape has the telling of it, don't need me adding to the questions already there.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: In the logs... you mentioned a tribe called the Twisted Hairs - your tribe?
EN: {Anger}Twisted Hairs are dead, lost at Dry Wells, died in Vulpes' smile. Won't discuss their fate with you, not now - their past is {emph}mine to keep.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: In the logs... you mentioned a tribe called the Twisted Hairs - your tribe?
EN: Walk farther, see me face to face - you might earn more. Now, let the words keep you without me adding to them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I found some recordings from you on the road.
EN: {DUPE}The tapes... {Shrugs}didn't think those would be found... weren't worth the words anyway, not like I'd forget what happened.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I found some recordings from you on the road.
EN: {DUPE}Had the tech from the Big Empty, recorder a woman gave me... on its last legs, didn't survive the road. Cast it and the tapes aside.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I found some recordings from you on the road.
EN: {DUPE}If you heard them... they're of no consequence. Ramblings, reminders for a man who doesn't need them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: How were you planning to attack the Divide?
EN: Didn't know, but Couriers can travel anywhere. They make roads into places no one else will go, guarded or not. Was going to watch, see.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: How were you planning to attack the Divide?
EN: The Legion... thought it might get into the community through me, just as I'd found the way by following you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: How were you planning to attack the Divide?
EN: But you struck first, shattered the ground, and let your home burn instead. Nearly killed me. And everyone here, walking or still.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So the Legion doesn't know what happened here?
EN: No, they don't know the history of it. So send others to find out, more to die... at the hands of their brothers the Divide has claimed.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So the Legion doesn't know what happened here?
EN: {Bitter}It doesn't matter, the Bear's reach was cut off. Now only the Long 15 remains. Once that's finished, Mojave will be under the flag of the Bull.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not interested in the history of this, we're done talking.
EN: All right. Done with words, then, won't get you where you need to go.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So what happened?
EN: Bear made its shadow felt here, more than I could handle. Heavy guard, watchful. I watched, waited.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So what happened?
EN: And as I watched, studied the people. The flag, markings. Thought perhaps... if I got rid of the Bear... what you had given life to might come again.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So what happened?
EN: Waited too long. Hesitated. A Courier isn't meant to stay in one place for long. And then you came, with the package. History.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This is the first I've heard of Legion coming this far West of the Colorado.
EN: No, when they come this far, they aren't Legion. They walk as Couriers. Like we do.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This is the first I've heard of Legion coming this far West of the Colorado.
EN: And the Divide is the reason no Legion has been seen. None belong to Caesar. Not in this place.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This is the first I've heard of Legion coming this far West of the Colorado.
EN: {Quieter}The ones that came... were following orders.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So you are part of the Legion. One of their scouts? Assassins?
EN: {Echo, insulted}Assassin? {Beat, low anger}If killing needs to be done, I'll face my victims... not kill from a distance, like you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: That's what made the Legion come to the Divide.
EN: {To himself, echoing Caesar’s orders}Caesar’s orders. {Emph}Every supply line gets cut, every community that feeds the Bear... cut its throat, starve the Mojave.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: On the High Road, you mentioned NCR and Legion fought here... before and after the Divide?
EN: The two-headed Bear made its claim, dug its claws into the trail you made. For once, it seemed like it might succeed - cut a route to the Mojave.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: On the High Road, you mentioned NCR and Legion fought here... before and after the Divide?
EN: Couldn't let NCR stay in the Divide. Trade route, road the military could use... can't have two roads into the Mojave.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: On the High Road, you mentioned NCR and Legion fought here... before and after the Divide?
EN: {To himself}Not after the work we'd done to cut off New Canaan, other routes, killing caravans... all we'd done to make the West bleed.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: There's nothing to keep me from walking out of here and letting you rot.
EN: Spent years looking for you. If you head back to the Mojave, it's like nothing's changed. Can live with that. Had to.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: There's nothing to keep me from walking out of here and letting you rot.
EN: Wasn't sure if history would matter to you. If it doesn't, that answers my question.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: There's nothing to keep me from walking out of here and letting you rot.
EN: If you turn your back on your home, so be it. I'll remain here in the Divide for you to return. And you will.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not to blame for Ashton, the Chip, or the Divide.
EN: {Slow, building anger}All these roads, {emph}you walked. These packages you carried. Think it wasn't your choice?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not to blame for Ashton, the Chip, or the Divide.
EN: {Snarls}Of course it was your choice. {Beat}You could have stayed in the Mojave. But you {emph}chose to come, couldn't let be - not in you to let go.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm not to blame for Ashton, the Chip, or the Divide.
EN: Came for no other reason than you were curious, restless - always have been. {Beat}Had to know the why of it - {Beat}now, I'll show you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I got your final message.
EN: {Slightly amused}Didn’t think I’d be breathing to hear you say that. {Beat, “Still...”}Message isn’t important, meaning is.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I got your final message.
EN: Had to speak of it, in case the words got lost in paper, ink, or other's voices. Maybe even yours, in time.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I got your final message.
EN: Still, meant for you. Courier to Courier. {Beat}Belongs to you now, or history. Doesn't matter.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I found some recordings from you in Hopeville.
EN: {Surprised}The tapes... {slightly impressed}didn't think those would be found... you know the Divide better than I thought.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I found some recordings from you in Hopeville.
EN: Had tech from the Big Empty, recorder a woman gave me... didn't survive the road, on its last legs.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I found some recordings from you in Hopeville.
EN: Cast it and the tapes aside... weren't worth the words anyway, not like I'd forget what happened.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I found some recordings from you in Hopeville.
EN: If you heard them... nothing but ramblings, reminders for a man who doesn't need them. {To himself}Probably more, lying from here to the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: When we first spoke in Hopeville, you mentioned you'd sworn not to kill me. Why?
EN: {Frowns, slight testing}You know the why of it. If you don't - I do, and that's enough. {To himself, quieter}Shows trust only walks so far West.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: When we first spoke in Hopeville, you mentioned you'd sworn not to kill me. Why?
EN: {Beat, gives in}Earned more than that, though, getting this far. {Beat}We walk the same road, carry the same colors. Can't break that by making the road red.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: When we first spoke in Hopeville, you mentioned you'd sworn not to kill me. Why?
EN: Want more than that, walk the Divide. Answers'll come, closer you get to home... you and that machine.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So... what, they weren't that important then?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Hesitant}Maybe not. {Beat}Who's to say.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Answers his own question, more to himself]
Topic_Name: So... what, they weren't that important then?
EN: {Answers his own question, more to himself}You, perhaps. Found them, heard them after I cast them aside - maybe there was purpose in that.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So... what, they weren't that important then?
EN: {Quiet, downnote}If they matter... if history matters... we'll see at the end of the road.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: So... what, they weren't that important then?
EN: You wouldn't have recorded those messages if they didn't matter to you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So... what, they weren't that important then?
EN: [FAILED] {Dismissive}Words lost to history. {Beat, to himself, as if trying to convince himself of this}Wouldn't have left them on the road otherwise.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I found more recordings from you on the road.
EN: {A little uncomfortable}You scavenge words. Things I have no need of, no history there worth recounting.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I found more recordings from you on the road.
EN: Scour the Divide, claw at it for meaning - but my words will give you no answer.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I... think they tell me... where you were. Things you did.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Cold, final}They won't help you understand what happened here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I... think they tell me... where you were. Things you did.
EN: {Quiet, slight anger}And they won't help you understand me. {Disdain}Keep them, listen, study them - they won't help you here in the Divide.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I... think they tell me... where you were. Things you did.
EN: No, there's a pattern. The more I hear, the more I understand your history.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I... think they tell me... where you were. Things you did.
EN: {DUPE}[FAILED] {Dismissive}Words lost to history. {Beat, to himself, as if trying to convince himself of this}Wouldn't have left them on the road otherwise.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So... what, they weren't that important then?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Hesitant}Maybe not. {Beat}Who's to say.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Answers his own question, more to himself]
Topic_Name: So... what, they weren't that important then?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So... what, they weren't that important then?
EN: {Quiet, downnote}If they matter... if history matters... we'll see at the end of the road.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: So... what, they weren't that important then?
EN: You wouldn't have recorded those messages if they didn't matter to you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So... what, they weren't that important then?
EN: {DUPE}[FAILED] {Dismissive}Words lost to history. {Beat, to himself, as if trying to convince himself of this}Wouldn't have left them on the road otherwise.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You're going after the Long 15? That's more miles than Legion can hold.
EN: {Sneers, contempt}Won't {emph}hold it. Divide taught me you don't need to - just cut it off.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You're going after the Long 15? That's more miles than Legion can hold.
EN: Then the Mojave will fall, Bear will starve, its flag will burn. It's spent too long dying, the Long 15 will end it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What do you mean, "when it woke?"
EN: Machine couldn't speak by itself. Needed a terminal to access it... like the terminals in the silos here, or the machine with you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What do you mean, "when it woke?"
EN: {Quiet}When it was connected, it started speaking. And the Divide answered.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: But what was it?
EN: {Slightly dismissive, like not important}It was a piece of machinery... military, holding memories, codes, maybe. {Frowns}When it woke, made these sounds... words.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: But what was it?
EN: {Somber remembering}When it spoke, the Divide became fire, the ground... tore apart like the skies. {Beat, this is the punchline}Through it all, kept calling out - maybe calling for home.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand why you didn't kill me in Primm.
EN: {To himself}Promises to keep. 'Courier shall not kill Courier.' Always - let them live, spread the word.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I don't understand why you didn't kill me in Primm.
EN: [Legion] You didn't kill me in Primm because you still thought I was Legion.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand why you didn't kill me in Primm.
EN: Caesar's orders. Some time before I realized the why of it. {Beat}Wasn't just you. {Emph}All couriers.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand why you didn't kill me in Primm.
EN: No telling how many were Legion. Maybe all of them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand why you didn't kill me in Primm.
EN: Wasn't sure about you. Until the Divide... all the NCR burning... that much death, it bears the mark of a Legion hand.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand why you didn't kill me in Primm.
EN: {Frowns}But you killed like NCR. Like Hanlon, with mines, bombs... missiles. Killed Legion along with the Bear. Like a coward, kills from a distance.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand why you didn't kill me in Primm.
EN: If you were Legion, then NCR beat you, the West changed you.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I don't understand why you didn't kill me in Primm.
EN: You said you made a promise not to kill me. Why?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand why you didn't kill me in Primm.
EN: {To himself}Promises to keep. 'Courier shall not kill Courier.' Always - let them live, spread the word.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What's our history? How do you know me?
EN: I knew {emph}of you, your name. Your road, to and from the Divide, what that meant for the Legion.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What's our history? How do you know me?
EN: We never spoke, knew you through your actions. Knew you'd walked the West as I'd walked the East. Learned different lessons.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What's our history? How do you know me?
EN: And I would never have discovered the Divide without you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I want to know more about this package I delivered.
EN: {Disdain}You know what it was. {Remembering}Had the symbols of America on it. New markings. From after the Great War.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I want to know more about this package I delivered.
EN: {To himself}Thought it might be America come again. {Beat}Promise of another future. Another flag.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Before I go any farther, I deserve some answers.
EN: {Acknowledging, slow}You've seen the Divide, walked it - farther than I thought you would. {Beat, to himself}Not sure how much farther you have in you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Before I go any farther, I deserve some answers.
EN: If you need answers, speak. You've earned them... {to himself}even if only you and I can carry them from here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Before I go any farther, I deserve some answers.
EN: {Frowns}If I have the answers, you've earned them.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Before I go any farther, I deserve some answers.
EN: There's more I need to know.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {DUPE}I... think they tell me... where you were. Things you did.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Cold, final}They won't help you understand what happened here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {DUPE}I... think they tell me... where you were. Things you did.
EN: {Quiet, slight anger}And they won't help you understand me. {Disdain}Keep them, listen, study them - they won't help you here in the Divide.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: {DUPE}I... think they tell me... where you were. Things you did.
EN: I've been collecting them. Listen to you talk about history enough, maybe I'll understand.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {DUPE}I... think they tell me... where you were. Things you did.
EN: {DUPE}[FAILED] {Dismissive}Words lost to history. {Beat, to himself, as if trying to convince himself of this}Wouldn't have left them on the road otherwise.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: {DUPE}So... what, they weren't that important then?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Hesitant}Maybe not. {Beat}Who's to say.

ActorNotes: [Answers his own question, more to himself]
Topic_Name: {DUPE}So... what, they weren't that important then?
EN: {Answers his own question, more to himself}You, perhaps. Found them, heard them after I cast them aside - maybe there was purpose in that.

EN: {Quiet, downnote}If they matter... if history matters... we'll see at the end of the road.

EN: You wouldn't have recorded those messages if they didn't matter to you.
