EN: {DUPE}[FAILED] {Dismissive}Words lost to history. {Beat, to himself, as if trying to convince himself of this}Wouldn't have left them on the road otherwise.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I found some recordings from you on the road.
EN: {DUPE}The tapes... {Shrugs}didn't think those would be found... weren't worth the words anyway, not like I'd forget what happened.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I found some recordings from you on the road.
EN: {DUPE}Had the tech from the Big Empty, recorder a woman gave me... on its last legs, didn't survive the road. Cast it and the tapes aside.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I found some recordings from you on the road.
EN: {DUPE}If you heard them... they're of no consequence. Ramblings, reminders for a man who doesn't need them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I found some recordings from you on the road.
EN: {A little uncomfortable}You scavenge words. Things I have no need of, no history there worth recounting.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I found some recordings from you on the road.
EN: Scour the Divide, claw at it for meaning - but my words will give you no answer.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I found some recordings from you on the road.
EN: I want to talk more about your recordings I found here in the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I was never a Legion agent.
EN: I know that now. Doesn't change what was done. The Legion who died here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I was never a Legion agent.
EN: Even if you were Legion, you would answer for those deaths by Caesar's law.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I haven't listened to them all. If there's time, I will.
EN: As I said before... it's of no consequence. Never intended you to find them, never intended you to {emph}hear them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I haven't listened to them all. If there's time, I will.
EN: Questions in those tapes I still haven't found answers to. You won't be the one to give them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Then you learned the wrong message.
EN: {Smug, confident}Really. Who's to say the truth of it. You? No. You walked {emph}from this, turned your back on it. Now you and others will answer for it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Then you learned the wrong message.
EN: I'll start with the West. Let that burn. Then... if the East falters after, I'll bring the Divide there as well.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Then you learned the wrong message.
EN: {Quiet}Burn away the flags. {Beat}Begin again.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Hesitant}Your actions have carried strength.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: [NCR] Even if you have no faith in the NCR, I do. My actions have proven it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Hesitant}There is conviction in your words, enough to rival a Legate, perhaps Caesar. You believe what you say.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: [Legion] The Legion is stronger than you know. If you would judge them, hear me first.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Hesitant}Your actions have carried strength. More importantly, not for House, but for the families on the Strip.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: [Vegas] Even if you have no faith in Vegas, I do... and my actions have proven it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: [FAILED] Words are not enough to bear the weight of your flag - {disdain}if you follow anything at all.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: Speeches are things of NCR, words without strength. Your actions have shown nothing. {Beat}Your flag will burn. The Mojave will follow.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: [NCR] You might not believe in nations. I do.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: [FAILED] You came from the West, walked there. You carry its sickness East to the Legion - and do not believe their cause enough to honor them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: What I give the Legion is a swifter death than the disease you bring. You have not the strength to bear a Legion standard.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: [Legion] You might not believe in nations. I do.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: [FAILED] You serve Vegas ghosts, not the tribes Vegas devoured. House is not the people of Vegas - you have walked the Strip, yet have seen nothing.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: Your carelessness for the paths you walk - it has destroyed the city you serve. {Beat}NCR will burn. Then the walls of Vegas will follow.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: [Vegas] You might not believe in nations. I do.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: [FAILED] {Cold}Yet you follow nothing at all.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: You have walked the Mojave, let the shadow of flags fall upon you, yet walk carelessly, no allegiance. Your words - empty as your actions.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: [Rep] You might not believe in nations. I do.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: If you speak for the two-headed Bear, I'll hear your words. Even if I will be the only one to hear them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: If you believe it should not die this day... then answer me why.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: {Suspicious}If you feel I do not know the Legion's strength - then I will listen.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: If the ghosts of Vegas have come from behind their wall to speak for the West, I'll hear their words.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You might not believe in nations. I do.
EN: If you believe that Vegas does not deserve to die as the Bear does... then answer me why.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What makes you think this leads home?
EN: All roads lead back to one's home. Not your birthplace maybe, but home.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This road leads nowhere. There's nothing in the Divide.
EN: Many in the Mojave think the Divide's nothing but canyon and storm. {Beat}Wasn't always.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This road leads nowhere. There's nothing in the Divide.
EN: {Starts getting nostalgic}There was life, a town, farther West... not talking about an Old World town like Hopeville... more recent. Something you saw in your lifetime.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This road leads nowhere. There's nothing in the Divide.
EN: {Nostalgia increases}It had the name "the Divide," too. But rather than cracks in the earth, it was a road from the West into the Mojave, a supply line.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This road leads nowhere. There's nothing in the Divide.
EN: {Comes back to present}Took a Courier to make that road. {Beat}You. Back then, you saw the road with eyes facing East. This time... the Divide's in the other direction.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This road leads nowhere. There's nothing in the Divide.
EN: And if your eyes try to make sense of it when you reach it... {cold, downnote}home's not what it was.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you think you can take it from me, try.
EN: {Cold}The machine you brought is mine now, it's coming home. {Snarling, talking about torturing the robot}I'll reduce it to parts, just enough to function, to be aware of what's happening.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What? ED-E?
EN: {Derision}You gave it a name. What was it to you? Companion? Slave... weapon? All of that, nothing compared to its primary function.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you bomb the West and East... is this how things should end?
EN: {DUPE}[SUCCEEDED] {Reluctant}History has proven this. Our history.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you bomb the West and East... is this how things should end?
EN: {Slow, considering}You seek to use your own crimes to prevent mine. There... is a strange honor in that. Perhaps the shadow of the Bull does walk with you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you bomb the West and East... is this how things should end?
EN: {Prove it}The West, the East - they are not the Divide, and nothing you can do can prevent the missile's launch. {Testing, slow in the middle}Convincing me - changes nothing.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: If you bomb the West and East... is this how things should end?
EN: There is no honor in murder from a distance, NCR or Legion. You know this from the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you bomb the West and East... is this how things should end?
EN: [FAILED] {Scoffs}You answer me with questions. {Sneers}Doubt. You were strong enough to come here - but not strong enough to speak for all the Legion.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you bomb the West and East... is this how things should end?
EN: {Cold}This is the ending they deserve... a flag is a thing of the people that gather to it, as are all symbols.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you bomb the West and East... is this how things should end?
EN: {Acknowledging player's strength, but...}You believe. Yet you do not see that killing a symbol with its own weapon carries justice of its own... just as it will when the East dies as well.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Vegas earned its right to survive, its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
EN: {DUPE}[SUCCEEDED] {Reluctant}History has proven this. Our history.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Vegas earned its right to survive, its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
EN: {Slight disdain}And you think that you have this strength? Enough to hold up NCR, long enough so that Vegas may live again?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Vegas earned its right to survive, its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
EN: {Prove it}Even if you speak for Vegas and its ghosts, nothing you can do can prevent the missile's launch. {Testing, slow in the middle}Convincing me - changes nothing.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Vegas earned its right to survive, its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
EN: You told me once I gave life to the Divide. I can do it again, and give life to Vegas.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Vegas earned its right to survive, its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
EN: {DUPE}[FAILED] No... your answer is not enough.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Vegas earned its right to survive, its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
EN: {Cold}They deserve what comes. Vegas is born of the corrupt, the  blind, lost, that gather to it. Without them... it would fall dark.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Vegas earned its right to survive, its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
EN: You believe. Yet... you have been blinded by the wrong symbol. {Slightly sympathetic}Let its light give you what strength it can... today marks its end.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The Divide? What do you mean?
EN: {Thinking, resolved to die}Our enemies gather outside... shadows of the Bear and Bull... they will have found their way in, just as you did.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The Divide? What do you mean?
EN: {Quiet, rueful}It was always my intention - in case I could not kill you, the Marked Men would flood this place, cut off your escape.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The Divide? What do you mean?
EN: {This is the end sequence}If we cannot prevent what comes, then let us make our stand here. {Beat, final, somber}Two Couriers, together, at the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Player has convinced him, nods, slow, quiet]
Topic_Name: Even if the missiles launch, and I die here  - if I can convince you, that's enough for me.
EN: {Player has convinced him, nods, slow, quiet}It is... enough.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I believe that one person can make... or break... a nation. You already know this.
EN: {Chewing it over, slight hope here}It may be... that as much destruction has been written in the earth here... you may build something else, as you built the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I believe that one person can make... or break... a nation. You already know this.
EN: You have spoken truly. There is a shadow of a nation behind you, the hope of a people... yet it may not matter. The Divide still stands against us.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Well, I just said all that because I'm betting you have some way to stop all this.
EN: {Cold}So... you resort to trickery. You were hoping that you could deceive me, reveal that somehow I can {emph}stop all this.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Well, I just said all that because I'm betting you have some way to stop all this.
EN: {Cold, player blew it}Fire will rain on the West and the East, as intended, and the last words of the messenger of the Bull - nothing but lies.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Well, I just said all that because I'm betting you have some way to stop all this.
EN: {Cold, player blew it}The West will burn, as intended, and Vegas will follow. The last words of its messenger, were not for the people of the city, but lies and deceit.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Well, I just said all that because I'm betting you have some way to stop all this.
EN: {Cold, player blew it}Your nation will burn, as intended, and the last words of its messenger, were not for its people, but to beg for mercy.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Because it should be given a chance? Its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Reluctant}History has proven this. Our history.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Because it should be given a chance? Its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
EN: {Slight disdain}And you think that you have this strength? Enough for {emph}all of NCR?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Because it should be given a chance? Its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
EN: {Prove it}The West is not the Divide, and nothing you can do can prevent the missile's launch. {Testing, slow in the middle}Convincing me - changes nothing.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Because it should be given a chance? Its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
EN: One can build a community, make it stronger. You saw it at the Divide, even blamed me for it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Because it should be given a chance? Its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
EN: [FAILED] No... your answer is not enough.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Because it should be given a chance? Its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
EN: {Cold}They deserve what comes... and should answer for it, as you should. The Bear is a thing of the people that gather to it, as are all symbols.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Because it should be given a chance? Its people don't deserve what's about to happen.
EN: You believe. Yet... you believe in the wrong symbol. {Slightly sympathetic}Let it give you what strength it can... soon, it will be no more.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Do you think I care if you fire missiles at NCR? Go ahead.
EN: You destroyed your own homeland. Seeing a nation burn? Didn't think that would matter any more to you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Do you think I care if you fire missiles at NCR? Go ahead.
EN: There's a strength in that... lack of attachment. Still, you're here now. If there's no more answers you want, then we'll end this.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You can't destroy the West, even with all the missiles here.
EN: {Scoffs}No need to destroy the Bear, just cut its throat.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You can't destroy the West, even with all the missiles here.
EN: You taught me that at the Divide - only need to cut off the supply line, the road, to watch something greater die.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You can't destroy the West, even with all the missiles here.
EN: I'll turn the Long 15 into miles of fire, cut off the Mojave. NCR will fall back, lose Hoover Dam... and leave their throats exposed to the Legion.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >
EN: And knowing that you believe in the Bear's sickness and have given it strength... then that gives more reason to lay waste to your homeland.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >
EN: The sickness of the Bear already lies within you, even if you uphold the East. If there were time, I would let you kill the Legion.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >
EN: But no, the Legion will burn as well. Without the West to challenge it... its shore will be closer than before. It will feed on itself, die.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >
EN: Without NCR to support it, Vegas will fall to the Legion. That grave of lights, back to dust and ghosts, as was meant.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >
EN: After this, only one flag will remain over the Mojave. Let that one fly, or destroy itself.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >
EN: You don't see, listen - even when it's all around you, no matter if I nailed it into your head like a gift from Caesar.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >
EN: You brought the Divide to life, Courier. You walked the road. Brought the Bear, then the Bull, brought me, following your tracks.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >
EN: And when I saw the Divide you made, I saw a second chance, a new way of thinking. {Beat}My world - no longer the East.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >
EN: Then you brought the West in that package. Destroyed it all. Nearly killed me, flesh and spirit.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >
EN: You destroyed something larger than the Bear, greater than the Bull. And even when you could have turned away, you brought it again, in that machine.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Topic Storage: End Sequence with Ulysses in Temple. Do not translate. >
EN: You destroyed a nation taking its first breath. {Low}A place that could have been my {emph}home. {Beat}Now, I'll destroy yours.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This is between you and me, not anyone else.
EN: No... the paths we've walked. The roads, and the flags above them, carry equal blame.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So, what - you intend to bomb the Mojave?
EN: No, the West. The East. It doesn't matter - the death of either one kills the other, Vegas along with it. {Beat}The West shall answer first.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So, what - you intend to bomb the Mojave?
EN: No, not the Mojave. The West, all that's been built since America died. Same symbols as before the war, now a flag carried by a tribe of children.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So, what - you intend to bomb the Mojave?
EN: You walked the West, didn't stay. You know the reason... the Bear grows without structure, follows a symbol without knowing its history.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What happened at the Divide, what I did, was an accident. What you're doing - it's madness.
EN: {Angry, low}No, now there is {emph}purpose. {Disgust}I believe you when you say you were... careless. The Divide... the Chip... the machine you brought here...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What happened at the Divide, what I did, was an accident. What you're doing - it's madness.
EN: {Emph}Many messages can be taken from that, intended or not. What I do now is an act of conviction.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you blame me for the Divide, then let me answer for it, not others.
EN: {Scoffs}Blame you? No, {emph}learned from you. Both the weapon to kill a nation, and the strength to do it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you blame me for the Divide, then let me answer for it, not others.
EN: You showed me a road, a way to carry my message. {Beat, slight snide}You've already answered for what you've done. {Cold}Now the flag you follow will answer for it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Where is the package now?
EN: {Slightly coy, knows where it is}Buried in the Divide. Part of it now.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Where is the package now?
EN: Wherever it is, it's been silent... if it spoke again, we'd know.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Why would I have brought it here?
EN: I've walked the East. {Accusing}You've walked the West, more than I have.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Why would I have brought it here?
EN: Circle Junction. Reno. Vault City. Word of you at Fort Aradesh... Fort Abandon. Even further West than that, Brahmin drives on the Big Circle.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Why would I have brought it here?
EN: Whatever you saw out there, wasn't enough to make you stay. {Beat}Maybe the markings on the package reminded you of the road home.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This package... you said it had markings? What was it?
EN: Machinery. Simple on the outside, computer parts. Inside... more complicated.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This package... you said it had markings? What was it?
EN: Was the only time I'd heard a machine speak in the Divide, the only machine with a voice.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This is revenge for nearly killing you, then.
EN: Not the name I'd give it. Not the name the dead would give it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This is revenge for nearly killing you, then.
EN: Soldiers of the Bear died here... Legion died, too, my brothers. Still dying, both of them, all around us.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This is revenge for nearly killing you, then.
EN: None of the people that lived here survived... yet all of the West and the East, they hold on as the Divide tears at them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: This is revenge for nearly killing you, then.
EN: Revenge isn't the message I have for you. More than that... Courier.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So you blame me for this? An accident?
EN: {Anger, sneer}Blame? Accident? The names you hang on this... Courier... you carry death wherever you go, Mojave knows - or will.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So you blame me for this? An accident?
EN: I'll see you answer for this. The road doesn't end here, there's more to come, I swear to you.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Disgust, bitter, implication is that he wanted to die there]
Topic_Name: If you saw this happen, then how did you survive?
EN: {Disgust, bitter, implication is that he wanted to die there}Should've died there... but now that I know you live... {bitter}the machines here... {implied quotes}saved me. I was the only survivor, {to himself}or thought I was.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you saw this happen, then how did you survive?
EN: Your package, the message inside, awoke medical machines... close to the one that shadows you... began to build themselves, then others.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you saw this happen, then how did you survive?
EN: They only take what parts they find in the Divide, never roam beyond it - can't even leave the silos without a human to shadow, like hounds.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you saw this happen, then how did you survive?
EN: Maybe they saw the flag on my jacket, thought I was of America. If so, history saved me. A sign.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What do you mean?
EN: {Agreeing}The Dam. That Old World Wall.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What do you mean?
EN: [NCR] NCR would have needed this supply line open to reinforce the Mojave - and Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What do you mean?
EN: {DUPE}{Agreeing}The Dam. That Old World Wall.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What do you mean?
EN: [Legion] The Legion would want to cut this road off if it had been a supply line to Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What do you mean?
EN: {DUPE}{Agreeing}The Dam. That Old World Wall.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What do you mean?
EN: The why of it. Hoover Dam.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What do you mean?
EN: The Bear, NCR, couldn't be allowed to reach it easily. Long 15... Canaan... both bad enough.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What do you mean?
EN: {Disgust}Kimball, Caesar, House... you'd think their whole world was that wall, cutting the Colorado. {To himself}If I'd never laid eyes on it, never spoke of it...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What do you mean?
EN: ...but once found, it was all Caesar could see. That, and the flag beyond it, another symbol, big enough to challenge him.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What do you mean?
EN: And the Divide, one of the roads to it - Legion was tasked with cutting that artery. If you can't kill the Bear in one stroke, bleed it, starve it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What do you mean?
EN: That kind of murder... it's what any of the {emph}Legion would have done. Now... the Divide belongs to history.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Something wrong? You sound... mad... at my robot.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Hate? No. There's nothing to hate in metal... steel, gold. {Bold}Or platinum.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Something wrong? You sound... mad... at my robot.
EN: {Disdain}Your machine... it's just a tool, made of wreckage of the Divide... {to himself}all that was brought here.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Something wrong? You sound... mad... at my robot.
EN: You have a lot of hate for the robot with me. I can hear it in your voice.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Something wrong? You sound... mad... at my robot.
EN: [FAILED] {Disgust}When I speak in anger, {emph}Courier, you'll know it. {Dismissive, trying to play this down}Your machine? Worth no more hate than any {emph}other machine.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand. What message?
EN: The nations of the Mojave. Cracked and broken as the Divide... its people, the same.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand. What message?
EN: I have walked at Caesar's command, across the East, into the West. Far enough to know Caesar's word did not drive me. Far enough to see the end.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand. What message?
EN: You've seen it. No Courier, whatever their flag can ignore it. Why you didn't stay in the West. Why you wandered.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand. What message?
EN: There is no future in the Bear or Bull. The Bear is diseased, barely clings to life.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand. What message?
EN: And the Bull... when the Legion reaches the sea, it will turn on itself and die.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't understand. What message?
EN: Killing one will end both. And you made me see how one could do it. Your ignorance, carelessness - can be used with a purpose.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Slight sympathy for the player, doesn't get it]
Topic_Name: And that's why you want me dead.
EN: {Slight sympathy for the player, doesn't get it}My history isn't revenge, or hate. The road that brought us {emph}both here - isn't about that.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: And that's why you want me dead.
EN: It's about the {emph}message you carried. The one in that package, whether you knew it or not.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: And that's why you want me dead.
EN: {Slow, ominous}The message that {emph}one can kill a nation. Can kill a symbol. And all that gather beneath its flag.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: And that's why you want me dead.
EN: {Slow}I don't blame you for the Divide. {Beat, punchline}I blame you for what you made me see.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: And that's why you want me dead.
EN: {Death sentence}Now you will see what you brought to the Mojave, and that will be {emph}my message to {emph}you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So you believed in this place. What it once was.
EN: {Bitter}There was hope here, another chance. A new nation, stirring to life. {Beat}A place I could have set my flag.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So you believed in this place. What it once was.
EN: Not the America of old. But something larger than the tribes of the East, something larger than the houses of the West. Something better.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So you believed in this place. What it once was.
EN: The Divide... could have bridged both, like Hoover Dam. {Anger, dismissive}Now like the Dam, it's too covered in blood to see what it could have been.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So you believed in this place. What it once was.
EN: {Slow, accusing}You gave life to this place. I followed your road here, saw the Divide. You {emph}led me here, so that I could see.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So you believed in this place. What it once was.
EN: {Bring it down}Then, you brought it to an end.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Reflective, Ulysses is getting to the core of the reason of why he's doing all this]
Topic_Name: If you blame me for what happened here at the Divide - why do you care?
EN: {Reflective, Ulysses is getting to the core of the reason of why he's doing all this}The community that was once here... and the package you brought... both had markings of the Divide. Markings of America.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you blame me for what happened here at the Divide - why do you care?
EN: {Quiet, reminding the player}You've seen the marks, the symbol. As early as the Hopeville silo, maybe. Carried it etched on your weapons.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you blame me for what happened here at the Divide - why do you care?
EN: The Divide, its buildings, its people, were built around those same markings, surrounded them here...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you blame me for what happened here at the Divide - why do you care?
EN: ...markings like the flag on my back. When I {emph}followed your road to the Divide those years ago, I saw the symbol I wore all around me.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you blame me for what happened here at the Divide - why do you care?
EN: An Old World symbol. Strong, to survive here - its people, strong. {"Maybe," low}Outlast the Bear, outlast the Bull. Promise of something better.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you blame me for what happened here at the Divide - why do you care?
EN: Caesar was right to want it dead. NCR was right to want to rake their claws in it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you blame me for what happened here at the Divide - why do you care?
EN: Seeing it... changed me, just as seeing Hoover Dam changed Caesar and the NCR.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you blame me for what happened here at the Divide - why do you care?
EN: {Quiet}Seeing it end changed me, too.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] Killing NCR, cutting off their supply line at the Divide serves Legion, as do we all.
EN: {Echoing player's statement}Serves the Legion?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] Killing NCR, cutting off their supply line at the Divide serves Legion, as do we all.
EN: {Quiet, accusing}I carry no hatred for duty... if that's what this was. The Divide was more than that. Its people, more than that.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you're Legion, are you angry because I destroyed the Divide supply line instead of you?
EN: {Echoing player}The supply line - the artery for the West? {Disdain, player's missing the point}I have seen the blood of NCR at Legion hands many times.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you're Legion, are you angry because I destroyed the Divide supply line instead of you?
EN: {DUPE}{Quiet, accusing}I carry no hatred for duty... if that's what this was. The Divide was more than that. Its people, more than that.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] The dead? You mean your brothers in the Legion - our brothers.
EN: {Respectful for dead}The Legion who died here... they didn't deserve to die, like those that died in the fires of Boulder City... {sneering to self}bombs, Hanlon's gifts.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] The dead? You mean your brothers in the Legion - our brothers.
EN: {Respectful}Their deaths were mercy compared to those who still walk. Any who die beneath the flag of the Bull... their death should be in battle.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] The dead? You mean your brothers in the Legion - our brothers.
EN: {Quiet}But no... the dead number more than my brothers.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [NCR] The dead? You mean the Republic troops who were here?
EN: {Derisive}The soldiers of the Bear? They were dead already, their symbol... diseased. Deserved to die as my brothers did at Boulder City, mines, bombs.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [NCR] The dead? You mean the Republic troops who were here?
EN: {Sneers}I carry nothing for them. Their deaths here were a mercy - compared to the ones that still walk the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: When you speak of the dead - you mean the Marked Men? The Legion and NCR?
EN: {DUPE}{Derisive}The soldiers of the Bear? They were dead already, their symbol... diseased. Deserved to die as my brothers did at Boulder City, mines, bombs.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: When you speak of the dead - you mean the Marked Men? The Legion and NCR?
EN: {DUPE}{Sneers}I carry nothing for them. Their deaths here were a mercy - compared to the ones that still walk the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: When you speak of the dead - you mean the Marked Men? The Legion and NCR?
EN: {Quiet, respectful}As for my brothers in the Legion... they deserved to die in battle, as do all beneath the flag of the Bull.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: When you speak of the dead - you mean the Marked Men? The Legion and NCR?
EN: {DUPE}{Quiet}But no... the dead number more than my brothers.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The Divide explosion... what, did I kill your family? Your wife - children?
EN: {Derisive, echoes player's comment}My family? My tribe lives... {but}its history? Died long ago, fell under the shadow of the Bull... consumed by another symbol.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The Divide explosion... what, did I kill your family? Your wife - children?
EN: No, this isn't about family - or any common blood. It's blood shared by {emph}acts, not by chance.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So you're angry because I accidentally brought an explosive to the Divide?
EN: {Anger}Accident? Ignorance is a {emph}choice. The Chip - a choice.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So you're angry because I accidentally brought an explosive to the Divide?
EN: {More to himself}As for anger... it is what I carry for the dead, and all that come here.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Slow anger, being cagey here, doesn't want to show hand]
Topic_Name: "The why of it?" You're the one who needs to answer that - why are you doing this?
EN: {Slow anger, being cagey here, doesn't want to show hand}Want to hear the answer of it. Not just history's answer... your answer for what happened here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] I'll see that you answer for it.
EN: {Disgust}Then Legion kills Legion. Farther you walk from the flag of the Bull, the more West creeps into you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] I didn't side with the Legion until the Mojave.
EN: {DUPE}I know that now. Doesn't change what was done. The Legion who died here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] I didn't side with the Legion until the Mojave.
EN: {Slight threat}Legion doesn't know your history. I do. They find out what happened here, how many of their own died... {"they'll want justice"}they'll want an answer.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What's so important about him?
EN: What's {emph}inside that machine - that's all that mattered. All the machines here, made of wreckage from the Divide... and all that was brought here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What's so important about him?
EN: Inside its frame, it carries the message you brought here... and it'll do what it was programmed to do: {slow, pace this}whatever it can to get home.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What's so important about him?
EN: The giants here will listen to it. I'll bring the Divide to your home, your nation. Let its flag burn, just like you let the Divide burn.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What's so important about him?
EN: {Speaking to console}Big Mountain access code... Ulysses. Command override...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: What's so important about him?
EN: {Beat, quiet, like saying "launch" nukes}Navarro.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You want the robot? Why?
EN: {Taunt, derisive}It's a messenger. Like us... and it shares our history.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You want the robot? Why?
EN: {Taunt, then cold, he's enjoying this}If you feel its loss... remember you could have turned away at any time. Gone back home, and none of this would have happened.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You want the robot? Why?
EN: {Taunt, edged}But you had to make one last delivery, and that's why I knew you'd come, Courier. Couldn't stay away, it's who you are.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: It's proof that killing a symbol is going to be harder than you thought.
EN: Back to symbols and history, then. Hard to kill... like Couriers.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: It's proof that killing a symbol is going to be harder than you thought.
EN: You're saying when the meaning gets lost - that what happens here, can make things worse. {Beat}Happened in the Mojave. Flags of the Bear and Bull.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: So you carry two symbols then - the mark of America and the Twisted Hairs, neither dead.
EN: {Frowns}Both... both survived, pieces of them. Remnants, nothing more.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: But the Twisted Hairs survived, even after Caesar.
EN: No, they didn't. They were ended, completely. Became part of history's march.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: But the Twisted Hairs survived, even after Caesar.
EN: If you feel there is meaning in the White Legs taking the braids of my tribe... what they did... insult, not respect.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: In the death of that history, another was born, and you grew to respect the White Legs.
EN: {Disdain}Respect the White Legs? That tribe of jackals? Never.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: In the log, you said they were shadows, in the way they wore their hair.
EN: {Recognition}The braids I wore. They took that from me, thought it made them more like me, more willing to have Caesar listen.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: In the log, you said they were shadows, in the way they wore their hair.
EN: They didn't know what the braids meant, the mark of my tribe before Caesar came... before Vulpes came for them at Dry Wells.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: In the log, you said they were shadows, in the way they wore their hair.
EN: There was death in that meeting, even while Vulpes smiled - asked for our help against the other tribes.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: In the log, you said they were shadows, in the way they wore their hair.
EN: All the while, they were looking to cast our history on the fire. And did. Another tribe, consumed by the Bull - nothing left.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Slight confusion, doesn't understand what the player meant]
Topic_Name: I'm talking about the past, in the respect they showed you.
EN: {Slight confusion, doesn't understand what the player meant}Respect...?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The White Legs might as well have been your people.
EN: {Disdain, player has it wrong}The White Legs? To even claim they were shadows of the Twisted Hairs...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The White Legs might as well have been your people.
EN: No, whatever words you heard, they were not mine.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: But your tribe was New Canaan.
EN: {Disdain, player has it wrong}New Canaan? My tribe?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Any symbol deserves a chance to defend itself, by words or acts - not... this.
EN: As you defend it now?

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: It hasn't proven itself wrong. That's why the Legion and NCR conflict must continue. To test it.
EN: Test it. As you test me? As if you believe there is some other road here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: It hasn't proven itself wrong. That's why the Legion and NCR conflict must continue. To test it.
EN: Nothing can prevent what comes. The missiles will launch. {Beat}These questions - your words, or mine - what do they matter to you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: By your standards? Or history's?
EN: Both. {Snarls}Why do you care.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You said in the logs yourself that technology's a dead road. These missiles will solve nothing.
EN: Those are my words. After what happened with the Brotherhood... talking with them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You said in the logs yourself that technology's a dead road. These missiles will solve nothing.
EN: Then with the rulers of the Big Empty. {Beat, rallying}But it is their philosophy that was flawed - their weapons, used with new perspective...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You said in the logs yourself that technology's a dead road. These missiles will solve nothing.
EN: Those weapons can be used to kill a symbol that has already proven itself wrong.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you believe the destruction of the Divide was just, then I cannot stop you.
EN: {Anger, "Justice"}Just? {Beat, spits this out}There was no justice in it, it was an act of carelessness, a coward. Killing an idea, before it had a chance...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you believe the destruction of the Divide was just, then I cannot stop you.
EN: {Stops, realizing}I see your meaning. You're tying this to {emph}our history... but it is different. The symbol I destroy, it has already proven itself wrong.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Do you really think these missiles can kill everyone?
EN: Kill them - no. The symbol they follow? Yes, as surely as you did at the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The question reminded the ones you spoke to of their purpose, why they cared.
EN: {Cold, appraising}I spoke those words in anger, and I did not expect an answer. All was lost... I thought it was the end.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The question reminded the ones you spoke to of their purpose, why they cared.
EN: {Reflective}Past their graves of failed technology, they had cared about the flag they had followed... and the people beneath it. Even with them dead and gone.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The question reminded the ones you spoke to of their purpose, why they cared.
EN: {Rallying}But there's no answer in that. I do this because I care, because I believe it must be done.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You were trapped, needed to escape, and needed the distraction. It was the key.
EN: I never sought to escape. I went to them to get an answer or die.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: It was all you could say to prevent from being killed. That's what I'm hoping for here.
EN: When I asked that question, death was certain. I wasn't begging for mercy.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: When all seemed lost, you asked it even though you feared the answer.
EN: Fear? No. Anger.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: When all seemed lost, you asked it even though you feared the answer.
EN: {Derisive, player failed}If you've heard my words and that's all you've taken from them, then I was right to cast them aside.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: When all seemed lost, you asked it even though you feared the answer.
EN: {Disgust}If you ever had any ability to hear anything beyond your own footsteps... the Divide silenced it. Now, its voice will end you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: In the logs of the White Legs, you mentioned your tribe, and its past.
EN: My tribe? That log... {disgusted at White Legs}no, it concerned the White Legs, training them to kill. For Caesar.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: In the logs of the White Legs, you mentioned your tribe, and its past.
EN: There is no meaning there beyond the road to New Canaan. The history of the murder of its people. And Caesar's past.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: "Who are you, who do not know your history?"
EN: {Surprised}That question... {Beat, chewing it over}either you walked the Big Empty... {beat, nods}you found the last of the holotapes.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Cold, not sure where the player is going with this]
Topic_Name: "Who are you, who do not know your history?"
EN: {Cold, not sure where the player is going with this}The words are mine. Whatever... "answer" you think they hold, you're wrong. It was a question, nothing more.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'll let your words answer it, from the tapes you left along the road to the Divide.
EN: {Slow, surprise}My words? {Beat, contempt}And what do {emph}my words teach you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: < Topic Storage: Player mentions holotapes at end. Do not translate. >
EN: < Placeholder Node. Do Not Translate.>

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I still don't understand - why are you doing this?
EN: {Cold}You've answered your own question. And you'll die with that question on your lips.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I believe destroying the symbol is never the answer. Changing it - that's something else.
EN: {Chewing it over, slight hope here}It may be... that as much destruction has been written in the earth here...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I believe destroying the symbol is never the answer. Changing it - that's something else.
EN: One buried this place, yet it lived on between us. One may build it again - build others. Your history has proven this, here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I believe destroying the symbol is never the answer. Changing it - that's something else.
EN: There is truth in your words. But even if there is hope in change... it may not matter. The Divide still stands against us.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you meant to kill me, you should have done it long ago.
EN: I believed in what I followed then. Kill no Courier, Caesar's words. I honored them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you meant to kill me, you should have done it long ago.
EN: Other Couriers could have been Legion - like me. Now, our allegiances are reversed.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: If you meant to kill me, you should have done it long ago.
EN: [Legion] Being Frumentarii kept you from killing me in the past. You have no such defense now.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you meant to kill me, you should have done it long ago.
EN: Not if you believe in what you follow. Kill no Courier, Caesar's words. I honored them.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If you meant to kill me, you should have done it long ago.
EN: Other Couriers could have been Legion - like me. The truth is, you serve nothing, believe nothing. Killing you... meaningless.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I want you to die knowing you're wrong, and that's what history will remember.
EN: {Cold}We fight over how we will be remembered, then.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: No danger there. You skipped past where you build the community, moved onto killing one.
EN: {DUPE}Nothing can prevent what comes. The missiles will launch. {Beat}These questions - your words, or mine - what do they matter to you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Don't even suggest we're equals. You couldn't have done this without me bringing you what you need.
EN: {Sneers, anger, player's getting to him}You were tricked. Still, you take pride in it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Look, just the fact we're talking should mean you don't want to do this.
EN: No. You are wrong. Words will not bridge this.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The Divide survived in you. If it felt like something fighting for, you can rebuild it.
EN: {DUPE}Nothing can prevent what comes. The missiles will launch. {Beat}These questions - your words, or mine - what do they matter to you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You're planning to kill a nation from a distance, just like NCR - just like you accused me of.
EN: {Frowns}What do I care for your perspective. You walk blindly, foolishly into death, your own and others.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You're planning to kill a nation from a distance, just like NCR - just like you accused me of.
EN: You do not rule my actions, and do not mistake my acts for yours.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You said a home is a place you breathe life into, a moment where you know who you are.
EN: {Weighing the player's words}There is truth in that. History has proven it.

Speaker: Ulysses
ActorNotes: [Frowns, player's throwing words back at him]
Topic_Name: You said a home is a place you breathe life into, a moment where you know who you are.
EN: {Frowns, player's throwing words back at him}But Mojave's proof that no homeland is sacred... until the larger symbols are destroyed.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: You said a home is a place you breathe life into, a moment where you know who you are.
EN: Whatever is built, the Bear, Bull... even Vegas... will tear it apart, convert it, either with purpose, or by accident.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: "You can go home again, Courier." Not a message for me, for you.
EN: {Cold}My home in the East, Dry Wells, is no more. It is part of the Legion.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: "You can go home again, Courier." Not a message for me, for you.
EN: The only other home... the chance of a home... was what you built at the Divide. Then you destroyed it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Nothing more to say, I've already won. Everything you hate about me, you've become.
EN: {Frowns}If you seek to anger me, words won't be enough. Your moral ground is weak here in the Divide.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't think that's what's important here.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Slight confusion}Our history... {frowns}the Divide. That history has been written, its lessons learned.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't think that's what's important here.
EN: There is nothing more to be dug from these cracks in the earth, no more fury to be torn from its sky.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I don't think that's what's important here.
EN: I'm not talking about NCR or the Legion, I'm talking about our history.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't think that's what's important here.
EN: [FAILED] If those are your last words, they are weak ones. Actions would have had more voice.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't think that's what's important here.
EN: There is nothing more to be said between us. No words of yours will change what is about to happen.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I believe the missiles can't be stopped. If you believe me, though, we might get through this.
EN: If we must survive to carry its message... then that is what shall be done. I will not let America die here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I believe the missiles can't be stopped. If you believe me, though, we might get through this.
EN: But... it may not matter. Even if we lay down our weapons, the Divide... it still stands against us.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The package I brought was from Navarro, the Divide scanned ED-E's logs from the Mojave.
EN: {Angry}What do you seek to gain by telling me this. If you think that the symbol I wear is a weakness...

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Its logs tell of a place where America survived... may still exist. And it's falling apart.
EN: {Frowns, suspicious}You lie. There was only one message in the machine, only one message in the package you brought.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Its logs tell of a place where America survived... may still exist. And it's falling apart.
EN: The Divide bore the symbol of America... as did the package from Navarro. The origins of the machine is... of no importance.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: It has history inside it. The logs of what's left of "America."
EN: {Slight anger, what is this nonsense}There is nothing inside the machine except the means to awaken the missiles in the Divide. {Emph}That is its only message.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If my words won't change your mind, what about the messages in the Eyebot?
EN: The machine made from the parts of Navarro? It had only one message in its core - to get home, at any cost.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: If my words won't change your mind, what about the messages in the Eyebot?
EN: It echoes its master... and soon the missiles here will as well.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: At least I don't hide behind a machine like a coward.
EN: Machines... bombs, things of NCR, are your tools, not mine. When we meet, this machine won't keep me from you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Keep talking like that, I'll see you dead.
EN: You already tried once, won't give you another chance.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm no traitor, and when I walk, I don't hide my presence.
EN: Legion wears many colors, East and West. You... maybe blinded by Vegas's light, or the promise of that Chip.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm no traitor, and when I walk, I don't hide my presence.
EN: Or maybe you walked so far West, the Bear's sickness crept into you. We'll see. Your offenses before Caesar, the least of the crimes here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] You said you'd sworn not to kill me. If you're Legion, why are we at odds?
EN: {Frowns, slight testing}You struck first. Not just at me... at the Legion. Or so I thought. Not sure of the history of it now.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] You said you'd sworn not to kill me. If you're Legion, why are we at odds?
EN: Whatever flag you follow, or followed then... either way, you got too much of the Bear's sickness in you to live. Divide's proof of that.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] You said you'd sworn not to kill me. If you're Legion, why are we at odds?
EN: Want more than that, walk the road. Answers'll come, closer you get to home... you and that machine.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] Legion doesn't kill Legion. Caesar's orders?
EN: {DUPE}{Smile/sneer}What kind of world would this be if Courier killed Courier.{No sound file}

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] Legion doesn't kill Legion. Caesar's orders?
EN: {DUPE}You've got enough distance ahead of you - save your breath for the road, don't waste it on words.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] Legion does not kill Legion - but you're not that anymore. I'm going to kill you.
EN: If that's all that drives you, it won't last. The Legion... it won't last either.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] So... when you called me traitor in Hopeville, that title belongs to you.
EN: {Angry}No, it is a title {emph}you earned. Legion or not, you have betrayed more than you know.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] Seeing this place. It meant more to you than the Legion?
EN: Yes. And it did to you once, I'm sure of it.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] Are you angry that this explosion undermined the Legion's plans? It was an accident.
EN: {DUPE}{Anger}Accident? Ignorance is a {emph}choice. The Chip - a choice.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] Are you angry that this explosion undermined the Legion's plans? It was an accident.
EN: {DUPE}{More to himself}As for anger... it is what I carry for the dead, and all that come here.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: [Legion] If I destroyed the NCR in this place, why do you care?
EN: {Emph}Legion died here as well. {Beat, but...}What you did... that's not {emph}all that cuts at me.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is this how it must end between us? You followed the East once, you can do so again.
EN: I cannot go back. I wandered too far, far enough to know my home was lost to me.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: Is this how it must end between us? You followed the East once, you can do so again.
EN: {Resigned, a little sad}I could no more go back than you could return to the West. {Disgust}To NCR, and all its sickness.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't care what happens to NCR, but I can't allow you to harm the Legion.
EN: Not all the East will burn. The Legion does not need to be destroyed, only... contained within new borders.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't care what happens to NCR, but I can't allow you to harm the Legion.
EN: After that, it will fall as any culture bred on war, on forward momentum. It will falter, collapse.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I don't care what happens to NCR, but I can't allow you to harm the Legion.
EN: I will start with their camp at Dry Wells... once my homeland. Justice of a sort.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: The Legion doesn't abide traitors. What made you turn from the East?
EN: {Echoing, mocking, shaking head}Even after the road you've walked, you only see a traitor {emph}before you.

Speaker: Ulysses
Topic_Name: I'm heading back to the Mojave to settle some things.
EN: {As player is about to leave}Can hear the weight in your feet - you’re bound for that Old World wall. Hoover Dam. Maybe not now - in time.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I'm heading back to the Mojave to settle some things.
EN: I'm heading back to the Mojave to settle some things.
